If you go to Neyyattinkara, even if there is no food to eat, there is a walk with royal pride, taking a towel and tying it around the neck. Both these groups are the ones who have fallen in this manner. I don't see any effort in you to change all this. It's not that you need sannyasa, you need the skill to live. For that, ancestral purification is to be done first. It is because there is no ancestral purification that you are showing all these guises. When this ancestry is wrong, the children born will show this and more.

Our lineage is the one to which God has given authority to change this. Brahmacharis themselves are needed to run this. Otherwise, when the institution grows, that glory will not be seen. Householders will talk about big things. But if they don't like it, they will step outside and say something else. Will the children of such people look after the institution? Then will the institution you created survive? This is why I say the Shudra's institution does not survive. They have created many institutions. But none survive in that glory. The Shudra has no tact. Right and wrong may happen. You must work it out without rejecting it by finding fault.

Didn't you see Sivagiri now, standing outside, what bad things you say? But are there people to work for it for four days? They will go only if there is profit. What else do you have besides the program of conducting festivals strutting around with the attitude of letting our name also be there? Chenkottukonam is being built up. What do you have to maintain there traditionally? In Abhedananda Ashram, a committee was formed in such a way that he had no choice but to sit there. He only came and went occasionally in his last days. Can anyone without caste sit among you?

You should not bring up this lineage in that state. No one should be able to mock the lineage you bring. There will be right and wrong in it. You householders yourselves must try to resolve it. This is your (Shudra's) time. If you do not respect this, it will slip from your hands. Then natural disasters or something will come and everything will be destroyed. Do not let that happen. Our prayer should be for that.

If entrusted with any task, you are ones to fight with each other. Those who stand to serve, then how much will they grow? All this will change only after spreading harm and destroying tomorrow. Then that effort .. will later turn into an unnecessary effort. You, those who stay here and those who come and go, do not have this wisdom traditionally . Similarly , how much humility should I attain, I have done good, how much more is there to do , how much sacrifice have I made, through that sacrifice what all have I been able to do, how should I live my life in sacrifice itself-- these thoughts must always be with you. One who cannot sacrifice and stays will not be able to achieve anything . Only sacrifice will remain enduring for you.

You do not have the culture to maintain an institution. Having established a movement, preserve the lineage, and use the culture in it to cure your flaws. Thus you must become a worthy and meritorious lineage. Ignorant young women come here. They are sent away after keeping them here for a few days. The thought of their husband and children will come into her life and her mind will ache. Aching will lead to illness. Despite everything, the husband and children do not come. Money doesn't come either. She cannot even lift her body. Such situations will come. It is then that they think, I could have lived in a good way from there. Everything is lost. If I get a chance now, I will live like that. Saying, "Oh God, if only I had thought of this then," they will die. Saved. Because then she will be born with this thought. That is the secret. That is why they are kept like that.

Whether it is a man, a thief, or a scoundrel, this thought will come at the time of death. They will fold their hands on their chest thinking, "I couldn't achieve this." Thus they will be born into hell in the next life. Then they will call out in pain and work hard to live. In the meantime, saying "Oh God, if I had got that I could have given to God," they will share whatever they get with God. Thus they will earn merit. Saved, right? Reaching this dharma, they will then reach karma. Thus dharma and karma will come together. If it is a woman, even if the husband doesn't tell, they will hide a little for God. She will live like that. Their children will also observe this and learn. They will hide more for God than the mother. Thus their lineage will be saved. That is what was said earlier, that they should get a chance to cry out and die like that.

Doing each thing in this manner, our lineage will grow. Pray deeply for this. Our weapon is that, I only have this prayer to offer. One should pray imagining that God should do everything for this. You, men and women, big and small, are striving very sincerely here and spending money according to your capacity. A small child will bring the first money they earn from weaving and give it here. There is a scene here that shows love to that extent. We must respect that. The benefit of this is bound to come either in you or at least in your progeny.

If we get a good knowledge today for such a lineage, it is God's will. Not ours. The prayer done here cannot actually be called prayer. Because prayer should be done by starving, calling out, and suffering. Here you don't have to suffer like that. Here there are all kinds of facilities. God has given it to you that comfortably. God is making us do it with such commanding power. You who have been able to play a part in it will certainly have positions and honors. But you just shouldn't have the habit of doing half and then losing everything at the end. Even if you only spend four days, those four days must be spent beneficially. May you get that flow of karma.

From today we will bring a good life; we must strive for a better tomorrow. You should go only after taking such a firm resolve and praying. Next time you come, you should pray stubbornly or strongly. Thus each time you should grow stronger. Ultimately people should be able to see you only as a model. Walk in such a way that others feel what you say is right. Do it thinking this is your need. That is what is needed.
Guruvani
Santhigiri Janmadinapoojitha Samarppanappathippu - 2001
The Evident Dharma Known to the Virtuous

In the beginning, when there was no knowledge, people acted like animals, demonically. That has grown and today reached the stage of Pratyakshavaham Dharma. In this Kali Yuga, the state is such that one thinks what the luminous object standing within that philosophical discipline is, and how I should be involved in it. This state is full of all qualities. The world is functioning in such a way as to mix and clear both good and bad equally, and extract its essence.

Our attempt is to bring this functional capacity into us, impart it to our children through that, and raise it traditionally. God has shown us this so that it can function in the best possible way. For example, even without us knowing anything, various imaginations come into our minds. When we say devotion, yoga, karma, or jnana, an imagination arises in the mind for each. For small children, there is one imagination when they see their father, for adults another. It's the same when seeing the mother. Thus, when seeing each individual, the imagination is different for different people. Similarly, a painter and a singer have different imaginations.

How did this imagination come into the human mind? It is the latent tendency of each one's soul. We develop it more and more. It is a secret residing within ourselves without our knowledge. Likewise, having many imaginations, an imagination also comes towards God. Various things appear in the mind, and the imagination about God is formed by mixing beauty, humility, truth, richness, and merit all together. It rises automatically from within us. This is an integration in the nature of the mind's growth. It cannot be expressed in words, but only experienced.

Devotion is like a great mountain of love. It is also a path of love. That love is feeling a glory towards everything one sees. An imagination that arises inside us unknowingly, finding a glory in everything. Children might be fond of toys or tasty objects. As age changes, this changes in two ways. One in action with seriousness, the other in emotion. This is something we experience. But it is not possible to teach how this happens.

It is when we reach a great person or a thought associated with them, where humility, truth, and sacrifice function harmoniously, that we know its weight. It is such a great glory. We are included in it. We who stand like that must think: I must mix this into my soul, cultivate it inch by inch, and act in a way that benefits my co-workers, home, and country.

Some will see it and leave. Others are not like that; they will endure any sacrifice for the benefit of others and work tirelessly. Although all are humans, for some, just seeing this effort brings anger. For others, there is selfishness in the aspect of love. Or ignorance in respecting or honoring whatever others do. Thus we have flaws in all aspects. We will attain culture only if we change all this. For that, we must come to a public arena, closely observe each action there, distinguish the good and bad in it, and reach the path where we must sacrifice again. We must set out for the sacrifice of rising up and imparting the greatness of this glory to each individual in us. It is through such sacrificers that we have been introduced to this much today.

How will we take this introduction now, and through whom? We all have knowledge. There is also an interest to take all this. But when it comes to doing it, there are many discordances where we are unable to do it, or if we do, it doesn't match, and we are unable to do it properly. We must remove this and move forward. We must move in a direction after deciding and considering what we should do for that.

For Hindus, first a Bhajana Matham. That is, a place to worship. After that, a temple. Then an ashram. Similarly, for Christians, first a month of devotion house. Then a church. After that, Metropolitan. For Muslims, a Thaikkavu, a mosque, Mecca. In this order, wise men have brought it about. Each knowledge has been imparted like this. That knowledge is also linked together in each religion. What is the meaning of this linking? Through life, spiritual and material matters are mixed and brought together like a chain. Otherwise, people will leave.

The Guru-disciple relationship is not like that. Entrusting the protection and punishment of everything in one place, they are retrieved from there one by one. This is the love in the Guru-disciple relationship. My protector and my punisher are from there itself. In a way, like royal rule. But this is not a king-subject relationship. Learning through life. Making him do various things in each life, gathering what he does with love and respect without impurity, washing it with humility, and pouring an immense, indescribable love due to fortune. Then there is no word other than glory there. We must act on each thing by absorbing this glory.

It exists only if we give the glory of father, mother, brother, and sister. The status we have brought saying 'God' is also like this. Before drinking water or starting to eat any food, we usually close our eyes for a moment. Even when taking a spade to dig, taking work tools, or taking a pen in hand, it is done like that. The general belief is that a cart driver, boatman, or mahout do not respect anything. But this cart driver will close his eyes for a moment when holding the steering, and the mahout when taking the goad in hand. When seeing this goad, the imagination in the mind is that the elephant should become alright. Or it will trample him to death, or gore him. The boatman is the same. Just seeing a shred of dark cloud in the sky is enough, the ninth festival would have happened within him.

We assume that those who fly into the sky in a big commotion are free as a bird. But once they enter inside, their focus is only on that until they see the destination. Therefore, where all do we need focus? The Guru's responsibility is first to keep us in such focuses.

We are now standing on a small path of knowledge. Moreover, we have started the acting of one part. So the first thing to learn is how to cultivate innate human love. We have an experience of pouring love without discrimination and with discrimination. We must also learn how this love should be in each position. Whether we are learned or unlearned, we can advance in the world only if we impart this love. We are beginning to learn by experiencing the glory of love in everything.

Devotion is the perfection of love. No matter what other thoughts arise, it will not be able to overcome true devotion. The nature of true devotion is to see one's chosen deity or Guru as God. A person who desires the love of God may have to endure extreme sorrows. In that situation, one should take comfort that it is to remove the impurities from my sinful power and stand firm in love again and again. Since he can see all sorrow as full of love and nectar, his sacrifice will not seem like a sacrifice when seen. Sorrow must necessarily come. Even if he is convinced that everything he does is good, if his fellow beings accept it, he will not be able to know what sorrow is. Without experiencing some sorrow, one cannot know what sacrifice is. Or suppose he didn't experience sorrow, can he understand another person's sorrow? Then he cannot experience it himself, nor can he know another's sorrow.

The love he has for all living beings will be in accordance with his dedication to God. His asset must be the purity of character not to hate anything and to see everything as love. Experiencing any sorrow and behaving lovingly, transforming into that by realizing and experiencing it. Then the seat of sorrow and the seat of happiness becomes himself. He will be able to see the earth as a bed of flowers. He will be able to see forests full of stones and thorns as flower gardens. Through the feeling he gets when going to such places, he will be able to enjoy all the beauties of the world. Through that, he might have seen God. Thus he will have a full mind to see God in everything. This is what is called sensible intellect. Devotion other than this is for the fulfillment of desires. That devotion will eventually lead to disappointment.

If the pile of desires collapses, there will be sorrow. Even if it is compromising devotion, there will be sorrow. Whether a true devotee or not, there will be many outbursts of crying. In reality, he sees the form of his chosen deity in all moving and non-moving things with all joy. Then unknowingly, due to the love capable of seeing the glory of God, he ends up crying. Thus a devotee who has seen God in various ways will cry out of love. Even if all this happens, when those who lack the knowledge to see love tell unknown stories and cause sorrow, there may also be a cry saying, "These people are causing me sorrow without knowing the truth, isn't God seeing this?"
Guruvani
Santhigiri Janmadinapoojitha Samarppanappathippu - 2001
Experiential Knowledge

I am telling you my experience. There is a difficulty in telling it to deceive. That is why it is told in this manner. If told in any other way, you will not be able to take it. Among those who come to me, there are a few who have known me since childhood.

I was a believer in God. That is all I knew. I know nothing else. I lived at home till the age of fourteen. I had to tell a lie to leave home. There is a custom among us to go to Palani. For that, taking a garland and vow, I wore it. Thus, under the pretext of going to Palani, I left home.

I went straight to ashrams. I involved myself in ashrams in many places. But I didn't get satisfaction from any of this. My entire desire was to have an experience. The Ramakrishna Mission and the Sree Narayana Mission are the two institutions standing strong in Kerala. I was very familiar with both. Then the lineage of Madhva and the lineage of Sree Sankara. They will not be useful for the Shudra class. Because caste is buried there. So there is no salvation there. There is an ashram belonging to the Ramakrishna Mission near my birthplace. I have been associated with it. Eventually, I spent seventeen years associated with the Sree Narayana Mission and its other temples. Not only associated, I also handled some things in its administration.

I observed puja rituals and all other rules in the Sree Narayana Mission. Whatever it is, there is nothing significant to call an experience from this. Except for an experience of two days, no other nature of experience has occurred from there. Therefore, with the desire that I need a Guru, if I hear that a person is sitting somewhere, I would tell some reason and go from there. Finally, I went regularly for ten years to a person who lived like an Avadhuta. I go to this Avadhuta saying that I am going somewhere to the branches of Sivagiri. For name's sake, I would go there once. And at night, I would sit entirely near this person. He lies in the sand on the beach. Even after going for ten years, I got nothing from him. It's not that he doesn't know how to speak, he just didn't speak.

While so, through someone, I found a Sannyasi. As soon as I went, he understood me. But that day he said nothing. Let it be tomorrow, he said. When I went the next day, he asked, "You are the one who came yesterday, right?" He lies in the sand and bushes. He asked me why I came. I gave the answer in one word. Saying "You are deserving," he hugged me and cried. He wrote me a mantra and said I should keep using it, then experience will come, and when the experience comes, I should come here. Experience came, I went. Everything is there but it will take a long time. I didn't understand anything. Even after two and a half years, there was no result. In the meantime, difficulties, troubles, and hardships come pouring in. I don't do anything fitting for that. At the end of the hardships, experience happened. But not clear. Except that it was proven true, I didn't know what this is, or what it is like.

Only if told as it is, you will understand. If told in other ways, it will not be clear to you. Therefore, I am only telling the experience. At least you should pay attention to that. He has a desire to somehow give me an experience. He says it whenever we meet.

One day, a situation arose where I had to leave Sivagiri itself. I hadn't done anything wrong for that. While wandering as an Avadhuta, he came looking for me at Sivagiri. And he told me one word. That was before I left Sivagiri. One day, after the puja, I was coming out with the plate. Someone who knows me came and said that a Swami has come looking for me. I quickly gave the plate and went. As soon as he saw me, he said: I am on a journey from here. You have a change from here. Don't leave without seeing me. He left saying this just like that. I couldn't believe it. Because I have been serving for so long. Without taking a single penny too. How old is the association with Sivagiri. How could I go from there? Or even if told to go, would I have the courage to go?

When there was no choice, I moved from Sivagiri. I built a hut and moved to the hill beyond Sivagiri for seven years and four months. On the fourth month, on the first day of Vrischikam, seven people came. They have come with all kinds of food items. They said, "Today we have a vow here." As they went back and told, ten people came the next day. Thus, within that month itself, nearly a hundred people were coming daily. They say that their diseases and other troubles will be cured. And those who come do see peace. This is the knowledge they told. After going like this for about two and a half years, nothing was effective.

It was at the Thuckalay Munsiff Court that the experience occurred. That was completed in about three years. That is, the entire Trimurti system was completed. All demons, whatever names are mentioned, all are there. What we have heard in this world is very little. What comes in front is many times that, in crores.

All this exists. But what spiritual strength will this give us? When making some offerings, one will get a result for making that offering, but when becoming people with experience, nothing is gained from it. It became clear to me that it comes for their spiritual peace.

Pratyakshavaham Dharma. Appearing visibly and explaining. Because it was taught like that, I was convinced that this is true. After being convinced, it became a question of how to handle this. When handled, it all worked. Not a single letter failed. This result is seen in hundreds of people. I was not the only one handling it. By disease, even those given up by the Medical College came and left cured. Even urinary bladder cancer was cured. Many people came like that. Then this also became ineffective. People started scolding suddenly. I had no idea what it was. I searched through all possible ways. It wasn't clear. Then, the first two lines of the Akhandanamam here were written and shown for two people and spoken as a disembodied voice. You must chant this and strengthen yourselves, otherwise you will face harm. But it was not understood. Since my name comes in this Akhandanamam, I told the children who got it not to chant it. Since it was told to them, they would chant it without my knowledge and without making a sound.

After three years, I moved from this place to the place I am sitting now. I went there only after being told three times not to sit here. There it was said not to sit in a way that two people could see. There is nothing in that place today. It just became barren land. It lies on the slope of the hill like withered grass.

After coming here and a little time passed, many people started coming. Usually, such crowds do not gather at Hindu worship places. But this was a huge crowd indeed. People just started coming like that. Again suddenly nothing worked. I don't know the reason for this. I haven't disobeyed what was told. It was said that it was because of disobeying. If disobeyed, why wasn't it told? The people who came were very many. If necessary, it would be enough to harm the ashram itself. There are big businessmen, there are those coming from great life facilities. They live on this stony floor in mist, rain, sun, and wind. It is for their disease to be cured. There is a small pandal-like structure. There are no other buildings. How many people can lie in this pandal? Everything went into disarray. But these people have faith in me and my actions. Taking a decision, I told them, I will come out only after knowing about this. You must look after these patients. There are mad people, people with stomach aches, and diseases of various kinds. Saying this, I went inside and sat. All these patients got agitated. People with stomach aches screamed terribly. The mad people, since there are no trees here, went to hang from trees in the nearby plot. About sixty of them got agitated like this. Those who ran away were chased, caught, and brought back.

By five o'clock that evening, there was a notification not to eat food. It was told not to even bite water. Two people who were merchants, saying that a rule has come that water shouldn't be drunk now, went to the well, drew water, and drank. After five minutes, what they vomited was poison like green mixture poured out. Swelling also rose in their bodies. When two others went outside, they got two beatings from somewhere unknown. With that, everyone got scared and stayed inside.

When it was five minutes to six that evening, a notification came that I would come and everyone should be ready for prayer. And they were told to eat food. They did so. That day itself, three patients were told to do things a certain way. That disease was cured. Thus in fifteen days, all diseases were cured. After that, I was told to make a journey. In that journey, I went up to Chidambaram, the biggest temple in South India, and then didn't continue the journey. Walking through each area starting from Kanyakumari, finally reaching Chidambaram. Even after going there, there is nothing to give. I decided I would go nowhere anymore.

Whatever has a name in this world exists. If we name and imagine knowingly or unknowingly, that also exists. But we haven't learned where and how to use it. This is what I was able to understand from my knowledge.

Worshipping with the knowledge up to the Trimurti system, and without any difference, I have seen its reflection with physical eyes. Even its sub-deities, ghosts, spirits, and demons are true. But what can it do, what should we do for it? I have thought and realized this. That is, I have thought and realized about the dharma of Kali.

If Kali has a dharma of its own, it belongs to the Shudra. Many Brahma Jnanis came among the Shudras. The first evidence for that is Sree Krishna. It is the Yadava clan, isn't it? The Yadava history is not only spreading among us, but we also keep it without letting go today. Then came the Parayi Petta Panthirukulam. Eighteen Siddhas joined in between. We couldn't see any of this as one and grow in the single system of being Indian in one language or one attire. Standing behind a system that spread in such a way that small gods for small castes and big gods for big castes, unable to stand together and impart, is what Hindus have done till today.

I am telling the qualification that belongs to my karma path, to dharma shastra, to truthfulness. Many others may have many qualifications. I am not denying it. I am not saying it is not so either. Because I saw what the spiritual form from the host of spirits up to the host of stars is, I understood that it is true. I can scientifically prove it by learning whether our form gets severed there. I am telling exactly what I have seen and obtained.

Our spiritual awareness is the ability to see how nine planets, twelve zodiac signs, and twenty-seven stars stand and operate and cause to operate. Otherwise, there is no point in saying it was like that or like this.

One must first study what the special power of the Sun that operates the moon dust falling to Earth is, and what the karmic path of Earth, which is its component, is. This is not what I say by studying. It is seen. If a person comes like that, I can explain it. There is this evidence in this part, and only if asked what to do for that evidence, can I say. Mine is not the knowledge that speaks by codifying scriptures.

We have now got the knowledge to do things like how life paths have operated in various ways up to the host of stars, how to liberate those souls, or if they are to be destroyed, how to destroy them, and if liberation is to be given to a worshipped deity, how to do it. If this knowledge was not there, I would have had to stand along with those who say there is no karmic path and there is no such thing as realization.

Everything is as we imagine. Everything is an imagination, isn't it? That is, Sankalpa Karma Manasa. That is one. Another is, if one was born as a snake in a certain life, what was the nature of that snake, what has come from that snake's life now, how did it come as an animal, what was its functional capacity then, what is the reason for coming up like this in those karmas, what is the reason for saying that humans themselves will return as animals, all aspects of this must be recognized. When knowing and knowing like that, it becomes clear what that soul was. That is how it should be understood. What each one was, what form it had taken, how that atom operates, with what color is it distinguished. This changed into nine. The execution of this nine is all that we see. Just as taking out a little bit of the same color, our thoughts and feelings can also be distinguished.

When distinguishing like this, the light stream of our mind changes and grows. That is not according to the calculations mentioned by yogis. Having nurtured it, I have been able to see what that karmic path is, which grows the Niyabhara bandha (Kundalini power) from the triangular shape to the Sahasrara Padma. It is an executive victory of life. It is only about one person. It is what is said as Kundalini power according to yogic rules. When it comes to Manipuraka, its shape and nature change. By then, all colors would have joined and operated. In this world, all kinds of things and their atomic entries are the subject of our vision. We can see the special operation of these atoms where blood, flesh, marrow, etc. join and operate. It is explained using color itself. Divinity comes only if a certain color is joined. Not in a certain one. There will be an element of darkness mixed in it. In the other, an element of light will be mixed. To say a certain light, a vision must be completed. When a vision is completed, for a state to be completed, when it is known and completed as its gross, subtle, cause, and effect, 7444 visions must come. Thus completing seven is the presence of God. How can this be explained. This cannot be discovered through science. Science has not grown that much. It is not said to deny that science does not exist. Science has not grown. When it comes here, it will collapse. A scientist can only reach the full form of research imagined by a branch of science, right? There was a science in India that thought beyond that, operated it with nine planets, operated in twelve zodiac signs, discovered its calculation and gave it to us, reached the stars and repeatedly taught us the birth qualities that reach us up to its fractional calculations. This is that very calculation being told. It shouldn't be told wrongly.

That karmic path that grew up to the Trimurti system in this way can only be explained by a Guru who is an authority who has risen to the position of Devendra or the position of the lord of Ganas. It is said that Ganapathi has the root authority for this, right? What is the authority of Moola Ganapathi, or how far will the karma of the form called Parashakti go in that position, all these have been subtilized and scientifically realized. Only if this is again subtilized, codified, and known can we be convinced about its evolution. Otherwise, we won't be convinced.

An action I do here to change this: Someone said disease. Is the disease real or not? If so, what is the cause? There is no effect without a cause. When finding out what the cause is, if it came through his karmic path, it is that. If not, if it came through his ancestors, it is that. If not that, if it came through his family worship, it is that. Turning it like this, the action that he needs to do will be made to be done by him. The karma standing completed will be caught here. When catching it, there will be a pain of karma in his soul. It will be in the body too. It will be in his actions too. After that, if he desires for self-realization, he will be told that way. Telling will be useful only if they have the right to it. Even if not, this can be told to a few people. Because they are their desires. When the desire increases, it will affect the karmic path operating inside.

The knowledge here is saying what karmic path is operating in any human being seen. That karma will help in liberation. No doubt. Each of us has a karmic path right from birth. How is that karmic path formed? Shaktheyam, Shaivam, Vaishnavam were worshipped like God, right? Until reaching Advaita, one has to act according to this. Advaita is something else. As long as one sits in Dwaita, what should we do. Can we just say we don't want Dwaita? Dwaita cannot be denied. It can be discarded after that knowledge comes.

Where will the part that people understand as Maya reach? Shouldn't it reach the position called self-illumination? Can it be done just by saying? One has to strive for it. Only the karma of striving can reach that position. Karma must be taken for that. One must decide for oneself what one's own karmic path and dharmic path should be. It won't work if anyone else decides. For that, we need a knowledge center or a research center.
Guruvani
Santhigiri Janmadinapoojitha Samarppanappathippu - 2001
Brahma Resolve through Guru

All the karmas we perform with vows and other rituals have results. It has been informed many times that this is not a lineage with knowledge for that. It is experienced so in the acquaintance till today. The reason for that is that we do not have such spiritual knowledge among us. We have not accepted Siddhi rules or other karma rules. But we believe in karma. Jnanis can untie karma with faith. That is why it is said that self-realized souls do not accept it. There will be only one or two such self-realized souls in the world during our lifetime. Others may be seen in plenty. Though Yogi, Bhaktan, and Karmi may be there, self-realized souls will be few.

Those with some experience tell us about the merits of yoga and karma and give us knowledge. But self-realization begins only after crossing the position of Devendra. Devendra stands in the sixth state. So self-realization begins from the part where the Indra of Gods and the lord of Ganas stand. The decision of Jnanis is that what is up to there cannot be called self-realization. But here we often call someone who has been walking around as a devotee for ten or twenty years a great self-realized soul and a knowledgeable person.

Self-realization is something that lingers only in the knowledge of lifetime after lifetime. Such knowledge means a gathering of all demons, all gods, sages, sannyasis, and jnanis. That is why I said not many with such knowledge come among us. And not everyone can reach that knowledge. If such a great soul comes, how can we recognize him? He will always show love to us in a very grand manner. That love will be with glory in a way we can never forget him. However, the disciplinary nature will not go away either. He might discipline us in every way. But we don't have the knowledge to stand obediently and listen or understand all that. The reason for that is the lack of acquaintance mentioned earlier.

Even if the ignorance of not being able to implement the idea that came to us in our time comes upon us, we should have at least the knowledge to listen to it and accept it. There are many who think that if they mock and despise everything, others will think they are very great. I am not talking about that kind of knowledge. This is very deep.

Although I was dealing with the knowledge gained through twenty-seven and a half years of experience, it was from 1973 onwards that I could retrieve it and obtain it through its wisdom aspect. Before that, the aspects of the Trimurti system were prevalent. From that, I had to experience many issues and hardships. That is because a god or goddess, or even a sub-deity, is highly glorified in the position of Pratyakshavaham Dharmam—even in the Vedas, Puranas, and Upanishads. Vedantins, on the other hand, speak of matters where the experiential aspect of Pratyakshavaham Dharmam has faded. When I had an experience like this, it seemed like a great wonder to those who were with me at that time. Then they became very worried about whether this was a lie or not.

The words told by those under the Trimurtis and the Trimurtis themselves reached a state where we could not use them. It was not known why that happened. We were in a situation where we didn't know whether it was our fault or a flaw in some other aspect. For eleven years since I started dealing with this, I didn't know what was happening. From the eleventh year onwards, I began to understand things one by one. After five years, I could firmly establish the understanding that we wouldn't make a mistake anymore. Yet, very few people have understood this even today. Even among the believers, those who have fully understood this would not even be two percent. This is not a field that can be understood so quickly.

We have been told to take up this subject through our karma. It has been informed that an understanding should be firmly established in all of you, and acting according to that understanding, great souls will be born through your children according to the magnitude of each one's actions. This begins to happen from the third generation onwards. Even the children born now have only a small knowledge about this. Although children born today have more intelligence compared to the past, they have very little knowledge about this.

Birth for the third generation is stated for our Pitrus. When we say Pitrus, great souls standing in various levels like Devas, Rishis, Yogis, and Sanyasis are leaving their Pitruhood and standing ready to claim birth according to Brahma's will. Now, the Pitrus who are standing aside claiming birth are waiting to be born in those of the second generation among the believers who reach full faith. Therefore, you householders must be very careful. The magnitude of the actions you do today cannot be described in words.

We have been told for what purpose these Pitrus are being born. Their activities will start here after twenty years. When this much time passes, there will be a change even in our current administrative system. The children born after 1973 are coming to the position of this knowledge.

Among what was told in the vision, crores of Pitrus (Rishis)—those in the Trimurti system and the Manu lineage—came and said that this should be achieved through karma. Karma means, if we make even a single movement, it falls under karma. That is why it was said that these Pitrus will be born only in those belonging to the second generation who can reach full faith.

Due to the karmic aspects done by our ancestors and the circumstances in which we ourselves are born and brought up, some shortcomings have gripped us. It has risen in the life force (Jiva). When this life force starts functioning, the vasana (tendency) of the life force and the karma of the ancestors combine, making it impossible to complete a karma. It will take a long time to understand this. You lack the tendency to take up karma that stretches this far. Here, there are those who believe the most and those who say they believe but change midway. All of them equally have the belief that "what I do is right." There are even those with us who think, "if what doesn't happen through me doesn't happen, it's nothing." This notion is never right. The attitude you should have is a pleading tone: "I am not up to this, I don't even know how much an entity called 'I' can do in this karma, let me at least try making an effort as small as an ant." Instead, you have the attitude of "I". Along with that attitude, acquiring many life cultures, you stand as a life-tendency ready to bite and die like an ant. How can you, being like that, absorb and achieve anything in this? Therefore, it is impossible for us to take this up together. Then, if we believe and follow, we might be able to achieve a lot. "Oh God, I don't have the ability to do this, at least my lineage should be able to do it"—you must have this dedication.

We have been informed about the growth of this lineage. I mentioned earlier about seeing crores of Rishis. Among them, I saw many Brahmin Pitrus, Brahmarshis, Sanyasis, Yogis, etc. The reason for pointing them out specifically is that this authority, knowledge, or wisdom has not been passed on to the Pitrus in the Varnasrama Dharma. On the day the completion karma started here, they came and pleaded, "You must save us." The reply they got from the Brahmam was, "Let it be, let it be later." When they came again, twenty-five percent of them were merged into the Brahmam. The rest have been kept in the subtle realm. They want to merge through the eligibility we are going to achieve. There are about three lakh such Pitrus standing like this. These three lakhs have come amidst how many crores of other souls.

Looking from the position of knowledge, how did such a great karma come to us, who do not even have the knowledge of a demon standing in the most despicable demonic state? We have no other word for it than Brahma's will. What is the reason for Brahma's will bringing it about this way? The mistake that occurred in the Manu lineage. After the mistake occurred in the Manu lineage, the Trimurti system was brought in. But the Trimurtis could not move forward. In the Trimurti system, it stops at Devendra. Since the aspect of self-knowledge is not there, it cannot be claimed for liberation. Devendra, however, is lying under the curse of man. So, Devendra has only attained a state capable of receiving a man's curse. This proves what state a man can reach if he lives well. Especially in the era of the Shudra.

Shudra means one without knowledge. Kali is the era of this ignorant one. An era where one jumps into anything without any determination, thinking it is supreme knowledge. It is in such an era that we have been born. That Brahma's will had arranged things well in advance for this right to come to the Shudra. In South India, especially in Kerala, except for picking up a few from the Shudra class and making them Shudras according to Varnasrama Dharma, knowledge was not given to others. That is the part where they say the one with physical strength became the manager. Starting from the Ettuveettil Pillamar, it ended with Chithira Thirunal. But except for the lineage of the one who becomes the king, others were not even allowed a place in the feast. That is the Vedic Dharma here. What knowledge will we get from this Dharma? This Shudra who is picked and mentioned has no other knowledge except to eat, dress, carry things around, sing, and perform Thalappoli. When it reached this level, our social knowledge went very low. In addition, if some Puranas are told and Advaita is added to it and interpreted, we are satisfied with it. We are the children of this level of ignorance. It is to such of you that, by grace, birth has been given in the Kali Yuga itself.

Kali is a mixed era. The country itself is mixed. All utility items are mixed. There is a mixture in humans, birds, animals, and plants. A mixture in father and mother. What is being said about those we worship and respect? There is a justification that if Panchali could do it, why couldn't we? But we only know this counting part. We don't know any other things about Panchali. We are mixed offspring living impurely by doing chaotic karma in this manner. No matter who says what, a pure life will not come to this mixed race. If told, it won't enter the head. A habit of achieving goodness by mocking, laughing at, and insulting when told stands with us. From this state, ours is a path given according to that Brahma's will to become pure. A path of karma where one can reach by oneself the level where Pitrus, Devas, Rishis, Sanyasis, Yogis, and Jnanis stand. Make one eligible for birth, give liberation to the one eligible for liberation and keep him merged in Brahmam, give us the authority to perform karma for the pure birth of children to be born hereafter—this is the path. You are the ones standing in the initial form of this path. Now, the householders in this lineage have the authority for this.

Those who believe in this should have a lineage of our own. Your Pitruhood is being lost by attaining liberation. The karma to give liberation to everything from the God and Goddess we worshiped up to the Brahmarakshas has come into our hands. This is our karma.

You have been made the authority of a purifying karma in this state. But you need the knowledge to firmly establish that understanding, think broadly, and grasp that karmic eligibility. Today, we can only pass on that knowledge to our successors. Do not think that anything else can be done. Or, if an opportunity for that is obtained, it is the will of the Brahmam.

Who will be the child grasping this knowledge? It is said to be the birth of a Guru who led crores of people. Children blessed with the fortune to give birth to such a great soul are born to us. We need karmic purity for that today. For that, you are working closely together. Never have the ego that "I am great". You should only think, "I am nothing, I am merely a participant in a karma that involves all of us." Only then can you think that there is goodness in you. We are all nothing. We should only have a sense of dedication that "we will do as much as we can."

There is another reason for showing the Brahmin Pitrus mentioned earlier like that. For them to get release from the bondage of the Deva, it can happen only through the Dharma of a Guru. This Guru does not belong to anything like a Deva, Rishi, or Sanyasi. A Sanyasi attains liberation and leaves. A Rishi becomes the authority of some matter and moves away. A Jnani says all this is good. They are all Gurus indeed. But this Guru is not that. The Guru who gives liberation to all these Rishis and Sanyasis. That is its meaning.

This knowledge itself will cause you a headache. Our need is to acquire this knowledge. This is knowledge. Where do we stand in the aspect of that knowledge? We have got an opportunity to call out "Oh God" without knowing any of this. Therefore, everyone should call out together with sincerity.

What we have seen in the world today is nothing. We have to reach a much higher level than all of that. It will certainly come. An intimation for that was received like this; we are a primeval lineage. The Manu's lineage and the Trimurti lineage are unifying according to Brahma's will, and the creation of another lineage is beginning. This is a small sprout of that Brahma's will. You have received the initial karma of the functioning of that sprout. When karmic purity is attained without discrimination, knowledge arises from it, eligibility is acquired from that knowledge, and when fortune favors, all this will arrive at that position. We must be careful until that fortune favors. Do not become arrogant just because you got some knowledge or become defiant because you acquired some wealth. Those are all qualities that we need to remove from ourselves.
Guruvani
Santhigiri Janmadinapoojitha Samarpana Pathippu - 2001
Importance of Pournami Prayer

We have an acquaintance of not knowing why the Pournami fast and prayer are observed. The Sun, Moon, and Earth—these three planets are associated with Pournami. The earth to complete karma enters the karmic field due to the movements of life that underwent evolution by the power of the Sun. You need to become acquainted with an understanding that tells you what to do and what not to do in this karmic field. Otherwise, do not disrespect these truthful words spoken for your knowledge towards a karma that destroys you by telling and enforcing fragments of Vedanta.

The result of Pournami prayer is exceptionally noble in a way that cannot be diminished by anything else. It is on Pournami that one can know the purity of intention of many births and complete it by acting upon it. The Pournami fast is a fast where the benefits of all fasts come together. By practicing all the virtues of this fast, one can become a Guru. It is also on Pournami that this Guru attains liberation. This is its spiritual aspect. Similarly, for the worldly aspect too, it is on Pournami that one can attain completeness.

The special feature of Pournami is that darkness does not spread even a little. On one side, joy and coolness, on the other side, the quality to capture anything. Seeds get more benefit in the coolness. That quality has the ability to generate and sustain it.

If one attains Samadhi by acquiring merits through many births, that Samadhi has completeness. On Pournami, the atmosphere is calm. There is no gap between sunrise and sunset. When one rises, the other sets. When one sets, the other rises. Wherever the rays of the Sun and Moon fall, all the above-mentioned benefits also enter. Pournami helps the Guru reach completeness as Ishwara and Brahmam. Whether you think about the benefits of Pournami prayer or not, you should resolve that our faults should all be destroyed so that all living and non-living beings get benefits, and distinguishing between good and evil, our prayer should bring benefits in a way that contributes to world peace.

Planets will attain equilibrium, and through that, a special power beneficial for world peace will emerge. Pournami is the most suitable day for creation and dissolution. Let that creation be one that benefits the whole world. Just as this state is seen in imagination in a mango blossom, it functions similarly in human beings too. Although the spiritual and the material are mutually complementary, whichever we give priority to will grow.
The mother giving birth to a child on Pournami should be conscious. She should know that this is for the world and that it has been ordained like this from God.

We have gone by respecting what currently exists. When we came through the path of the ancestors, some obstacles arose. After that, a deviation was made. You can ask how this was obtained despite respecting what exists. It is difficult to answer that. We don't think about how those who came before were. But we adopted such a path. How this happened is a subject to be pondered upon. Sivananda called Hatha Yoga as Raja Yoga. But Raja Yoga is none of this. True Raja Yoga is something one falls into unknowingly due to the good deeds of past births. For example, Sri Krishna. Krishna did not reject anything. He reinforced what existed until then and showed that he is none of this. Krishna acted desiring a karma suitable for the times. What has been done so far has value. But he is standing by stepping outside of it. Krishna is a perfect Jnani. It was as a result of reading the Gita that Karl Marx told to behead. But the essence of the soul was lost. An ordinary person's intellect should not function in things done by visionaries.

We have been able to learn one thing from the great souls who came and went. Most of them have rejected the past path. But to be able to see what the old is, one must come through the old itself. As far as we are concerned, we do not need the old. Because God gave us a new path. We received this path through a disembodied voice. It will only say, do this at this time. We couldn't know everything in advance. As God, we are being redirected from time to time. We are redirected through intimations.

Mistakes must be corrected in the Kali Yuga. And then let into the Satya Yuga. What sequence can we give to this correction? So far, what has been done is only on a small scale. More is to be done hereafter. Even so, I have been seen as a denier. A nature for this has arisen from that imagination itself.
From the words "The thing I desired for ages has been completed today," it can be understood that this is an imagination that is direct and existed earlier.

Now, how should this mode of worship be carried forward? Those who created each mode of worship did it after asking and knowing how it should be. We also do the same. We have another uniqueness too. We were given this method of worship without asking. Even then, I should not do it by myself. Those who ask, do, and make others do this have a responsibility. That is why I have said that householders cannot do this. But householders who live like Rishis can do this. That householder must be one with the determination that he will step back only after reaching a certain stage.

How and who should implement this idea? Anyway, I am not the one to implement this. Even if one asks, many know, and some think, it can be implemented only according to the karmic capacity of the one who is going to implement it. This cannot be implemented just by mere belief. What all should be included in what is called belief? There is a need for an understanding about belief. A word is uttered after it rises in the mind. That word must be put into practice. Belief can end up in the Ashta Ahankaras (eight egos). That is, the attitude of "I" will always stand out. Only one who can transform these Ashta Ahankaras into Ashta Aiswaryas (eight wealths) can put this into practice. We should be able to impart the love and affection of one who is so pure. You can work closely with his karmic capacity. Only one who acquires the Ashta Aiswaryas, turns around, thinks what is needed, asks, and acts can do this. Anyway, the path of karma must be pure for this. Even if one acquires the eight Siddhis, one must be able to maintain honesty. Disregarding honor and dishonor, one must stand as a seeker of truth.

It was mentioned earlier that doing such a prayer here is according to an intimation. At the time of doing this prayer, at the time of doing this prayer that resolves the mistakes of a long time, you must remember that if even a slight scratch of ignorance enters inside, it will spread. It will spread in many ways. We are doing the prayer to rectify the anomalies that have occurred in all the actions of householders, as well as in all the actions of Sanyasis and Brahmacharis. This is not something according to your mind. Therefore, some ignorance and mistakes might occur. We are being made to do a special thing at a distance that no one can say by anyone, there is nothing else to say about it except that it is God's will. You should always think, "May God grant that the shortcomings of myself and my ancestors over time, not only that, but the overall shortcomings of the people of the world be removed, and in its place, this Guru and the Guru lineage given to us by God be able to impart goodness of double weight." The children you raise and grow, and the youngsters standing here taking Sanyasa are equally participants in this noble karma. You must also think how it should be done if a path of redemption is to come through the karma you all do together. Whatever work you do, you should always think that not only through Sanyasis and their lineage but wherever in the world shortcomings have occurred, all those should be destroyed and in that place, goodness according to Brahma's will should come through this Guru lineage. When studying children do not get an understanding in their minds, you should pray for goodness to come in this way to all the children who have gone astray, not just the children of this lineage.

This is the word God told us. Boys and girls must be given special attention and prayed for separately. The karma coming from me, a woman, should correct the mistake of the woman in this world. The man should also think like this. That should be your eligibility. This eligibility of men and women is advancing together here. At that time, our minds should not become bad, nor should we fall into situations that make the mind bad. Especially the men and women growing here are the ones who have to make judgments for the world. It is with this sense of Dharma that we should become great. Standing in this Dharma, our prayer always should be, "Clear all the mistakes that have come traditionally not only in this solar system but also through other solar systems, and give us the knowledge, acquaintance, and experience to do what is needed when needed." When we have that knowledge and God tells and makes us do it, we should be ready to do it. Apart from this, thoughts like rubbish lying on the road should not be allowed to enter the mind. If this prayer is done on a Pournami day, it will yield full results.
Guruvani
Santhigiri Janmadinapoojitha Samarpana Pathippu - 2001
Historical Event through the Aspect of Vision

Let us look at the lives of great people born after the beginning of Kali to see whether they experienced happiness or sorrow. Gandhiji was a great man born as a materialist. Gandhiji had no spiritualism. Congressmen have acted as great spiritualists. But we have not been able to see Gandhiji having such a history. We were neither able to take up that sacrifice, nor participate in that Dharma, nor get the aspect of that merit. This is the truth.

A misfortune has befallen us that we cannot give contemporaneity to and develop people who have embraced a life sequence of so much sacrifice. What we say about Mahatmaji is that he was a person with a spiritual side. Let it remain so. We shouldn't try to change and say otherwise. Because Mahatmaji taught that Rama Rajya should come. When speaking about Rama, which Rama should we take? In Sanskrit grammar books, we first learn how many Ramas came. Where do we stand in the karma that says 'Ramo Rama Ramaha cha Kalki Janardana'?

To impart goodness in our country, God took the Vamana avatar and came. He stepped on an Asura who ruled the country well and pushed him down to the netherworld. Why did he step on him and push him down? Because he was an Asura. There is no question as to why the Asura ruled well. It is also not known why demonic nature was imparted. Going into the intricacies of such fictional stories without any information, whom will we ask and understand what?

We have not been able to understand the contemporary history of Mahabali and Vamana. For what, for whom did they do all this? Without knowing any such thing, how will we detach and remove the misfortunes and untruths that have crept into the karma we have been praising and glorifying till today? If our children ask us about this nature, what will we tell them? This is the biggest misfortune concerning us.

Here is where we should see Sri Krishna as a historian or a Yogeswara. What does Yogeswara mean? We praise Sri Krishna, saying 'Yatra Yogeswara Krishna'. So, what is the point of praising the author of the Gita, the Yogeswara Krishna, like this today when he came and we were ignorant? If someone asks you about Sri Krishna's end, what will you say? You will say that Krishna didn't die like that, he was consumed in the yogic fire. Then it's enough, right? We all got salvation. We are enjoying ourselves by babbling stories and asserting a lack of Dharma in this manner.

You should not study or teach about Sri Krishna like that. We cannot move forward without unknowingly thinking, knowing, acting, suffering, or in some way understanding that man to the extent of his karma and sacrifice. For us to be able to know about such a matter, we need the desire, persistence, detachment, and love to know about the state of some karma that aligns with truth.

What is Vairagya (detachment)? It is the reverence of love. Vairagya should not be studied in the sense of enmity. We must become detached ones of love. There are certain things in us that show how we can become detached ones of love. We must be able to learn to take up the karma that should be taken up out of this love. That can only be done through a renunciate. What kind of person should that renunciate be? Here we must see Mahatmaji as a renunciate. Not because he taught anything else. That man is indeed a renunciate. Even after getting kicked by British soldiers, he didn't take it as a big deal. How were we able to learn from that wealth of sacrifice he showed before us?

What could we learn from Mahatmaji's love? We couldn't adopt that discipline of detachment. It is shown before us that there are rulers, administrators, or people acting in its name who grew up in that lineage that didn't teach us to take that love and discipline of detachment in their true magnitude. How can we adopt the model of Mahatmaji's sacrifice that they show? We never can.

If history has shown contemporaries of sacrifice, no lineage has been able to adopt it. Without that, if we study the history written by people who are exhausted talking about rationalism or liberation-ism supporting and opposing it, how far will we go? Therefore, no one should talk about liberation-ism, no one should say any nonsense, it won't work.

What is the karma we need to achieve in our lifetime? Without knowing at least this much—what sacrifice is there in that karma, what hardship is there in that sacrifice, and how that hardship should be experienced—we cannot become worthy of worship. This is what is called history. The one walking before us as a great renunciate today hasn't been able to achieve anything in this state. Looking at it that way, none of our ancestors are models for us.

What does the Prophet's prayer in the graveyard during his last days show? A true Muslim cannot say that prayer doesn't exist. Whatever karmas were used to study about the renunciates, all of them have become subjected to something else and corrupted. For example, there is a song indicating God's love, "Who knew God's love, oh mind." Yes, who knew God's love? Will God come if you show it by singing, saying, playing, making others play, stomping feet, beating, and jumping high?

So, no more evidence is needed to show that we are bad in every way. If a change is to come to all this, I am telling you something known to me regarding what we should do. That is my knowledge. I don't know how you will understand it.

In the karma that speaks of Sri Krishna's sense of Dharma, see that Dharma called Pratyakshavaham Dharmam perceptibly. Not the empiricism spoken by current poets and intellectuals. What do these empiricists say about the sunrise? It burst open. That is, it's a bursting sun here. If these miscreants could lean such empiricism on your ignorance, where are you standing! The sun cannot burst or open up like that. We all know that. If you are taught about empty space and non-empty space in a karmic course spinning within these nine planets, will you move away from this karmic course?

What is Pratyakshavaham Dharmam? Krishna asks Arjuna, why aren't you killing them? I cannot fight and kill them. Do you trust me? Definitely. Then why aren't you obeying my word? It is only in the act of killing that I cannot obey. You sit and think. So he sits in the chariot itself and thinks. When he sat with closed eyes in that chariot, what did he see? There is no harm in killing them. So, is this how God comes? According to the logic of these empiricists and you, will God come like this? What are you saying—that one shouldn't cause pain even to an ant. How can you, thirsting for this compassion, kill this? How do Jain theoreticians walk? Tying a cloth over their mouths. How does one who says even germs shouldn't be killed live here? So will God shout that you and I are great sinners? How many living beings do we chop, boil, and eat. Saying "We won't eat these living beings," if you cut and eat the sprouts of these seeds, eating and eating its leaves and peels, isn't that taking a life?

What respect are you going to establish with this Advaita philosophy? If you are convinced of that matter seen by Arjuna, it will be good for you. If you want to say that you are not killing anyone, nor making anyone kill, from where would you have seen it to say that? Whether it is true or false, or a writing from intellect, it is a direct perception. That is why he starts the war by praying to Krishna. To Bhishma, who is lying on a bed of arrows after fighting, Krishna asks, you could have gone before this, why are you lying like this? Then Bhishma says, let this go Krishna ٹ.., this will go. When we look at the historical truth of Bhishma and Drona saying this, we can see who they are. What is the reason for Bhishma and Drona falling like that? Or, in a karma path where there are disciple and guru, why did Sri Krishna stand like this and get them killed? Why did he kill?

If you get an opportunity to think about this, after thinking, an experience of the history that came and went and is coming and going in this human Dharma should be available to you as Pratyakshavaham Dharmam. Again, what is Pratyakshavaham Dharmam? That fortune to see the realms where our ancestors' lives are stuck without progress. Other than that, it has no other justifications.

If one holds firmly onto the things Sri Krishna saw and taught and thinks about it, Krishna himself has shown again that those things are dangerous. It is that karma that ultimately became the reason for Krishna to fall over and cry and even for Krishna himself to say, there is no escape now, at least take these women and children and save them. When all these karmas stand in this state, who can firmly hold on to it and do what?

The words of the Gita are a perfect example of Pratyakshavaham Dharmam. But we have already seen what finally happened because of that perception. So what kind of perception do we need now? That perception must be obtained in Jagrat (waking), Swapna (dreaming), and Sushupti (deep sleep) states. This shouldn't become mere storytelling. Even if most of you couldn't see it, there are a few among you who come as authorities for it. You have Jagrat, Swapna, and Sushupti in your experience. But it is a few people who see the history of the respective times in these states. What is the meaning of what was said? This is the karmic result you get to be close to me.

We are taught what Sri Krishna is and what he did. Similarly, we are also taught what the Trimurtis, which is its previous state, are. If it is said that the learned one who pinched off Brahma's head was here, it makes us think what that karma is. Who pinched off Brahma's head? Why is Subrahmanya, who pinched off the head of the Guru and God, being worshiped? It is the heads of the father, mother, Gurus, and ancestors that were pinched off through pinching Brahma's head. That is, they all have only three heads now.

There are people here who have told and served stories like this. This is not what I am telling you. Pratyakshavaham Dharmam. Making it perceptible and seeing it before you. It is the children here who see it. What do they see? What is Krishna, what is Shiva, what is Vishnu, what is Brahma, what is Guru, what is God—lifting all this and showing them. This is Pratyakshavaham Dharmam.

You must bring it perceptibly to a karmic path that shows what Subrahmanya does to the one whose head was pinched and the one whose head was not. This is vision. A Dharma that settles things with karma after ending up speaking mere rhetoric is not our subject. We shouldn't do that karma; we don't need it.

God has given us an opportunity to completely achieve this. So that you have no doubts about it, I am showing the children here who have the vision before you. Through them, we can know. All the past ancestors and great souls must come before them who know and speak like this. They should come and tell them what the truth in their life history is. They must ask the Guru whether the history they tell is true. Those truths and untruths can be determined through the Guru. Only in this way can even the past historical truths be known.

So there is a karma here that can show your children in this state. Are there any other children in this country who can show you in this state? Or is this telling a lie? You yourselves would give an example to know this—that gold should approach a touchstone. The purity can be known only if gold is rubbed on a touchstone. It won't work if ground on a grinding stone.

The work done here is not for a caste, religion, land, region, or country. For example, Jesus will appear before a child belonging to the Hindu religion who has the vision here. Like that, people belonging to all classes and religions will come. There are so many people among the believers here who see and know this truthfully. However, they cannot look at and tell the history of great souls. Only the children standing here can do that. You should know this through those who can know it like this. Having known, desire to serve it through your effort and love. This is what I have to tell you. This grace of God should be available to men, women, rogues, mahouts, drummers, and everyone, if they are God's children. There is no rule that only so-and-so will get it. So, everyone must think what they should become if they are to be God's children. This is its aspect.

First, you must see in Jagrat, Swapna, and Sushupti. You should not move away from history or truth. Just as you see in the waking state, you must see similarly in dream, deep sleep, and Turiya. Only after that should the journey towards Turiyatita be made. You have got the fortune to this karma. You should think about what to do to reclaim that fortune. Thinking about this, knowing and acting, you must strive to reach the consciousness of truth, no matter what we lose. That should be your persistence, your karma, your discipline of detachment. That should be the truth you foster.

If Jesus could be beaten like this, people will come to beat and kill you too. Those who say 'I cannot die' need not come to this. That is, you must get the subtle bodies of past great souls and ancestors. You must find out where in the atmosphere, in which realms, that subtle body stands. What is the shape of the realm from which it controls you? What all happens there? How will you be taken to the story happening there? The one who tells and gives you this is your Guru.
Guruvani
Santhigiri Janmadinapoojitha Samarpana Pathippu - 2001
The Mistake that Happened to India

What is the state of a Shaiva, what is the state of a Vaishnava, what is the state of a Shaktheya? All these are the same state itself. One gives priority to Shakthi. One gives priority to Shiva, another gives it to Vishnu. This is the only difference. Other than this, there is no aspect of state transformation. If the one seeing is to have a change of state, if he has to ascend a state, he must get all three. Otherwise, let alone what he catches, the rest will lie there. All three must go together. When he catches his resolve and goes there, a story is set there in such a way that he cannot move forward.

If one follows one path, Shaiva, Shaktheya, and Vaishnava should be obtained together. The lack of possibility to get it like that is India's biggest ruin. Although Parashurama Gotra, Vishwamitra Gotra, Shankara Gotra, and many others are mentioned, all of them are contained within the Trimurtis. When speaking of the purity of gotra, all this must be contained in it. That is, the four classes of Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, and Shudra should be equally contained. If not contained, when the aspect of gotra purity comes, all this will separate. This mistake of separating in this manner is what happened in India.

At the time the vision comes, when the Vaishnava's vision comes, only that matter will be told. This Guru cannot tell the matters of the Shaiva and the Shaktheya. There is no point in a Vaishnava saying Vaishnava is great, a Shaiva saying Shaiva is great, and a Shaktheya saying Shaktheya is great. What is the point in saying 'Mine is great, the others are fine, they are good'? When the Trimurti system is completed, if the Guru is not one who has attained the position of Devendra, the position of Parashakthi, and the position of the Ganas, how will the disciple get it?

Because it has not been taught in this way, we do not know the correct aspect of the Manvantara. Because the knowledge about the Manvantara has come in a wrong way, these three sects in India have turned around and are fighting among themselves. Therefore, we Indians were unable to stand together. As a result, the Asian continent itself broke into several pieces due to natural calamities. If we stand divided and act like this, each time an era changes, a new danger will arise.

An example of this is the planet Jupiter. Jupiter is a large planet, isn't it? It is said that a comet crashed into it, and its face changed. In another time, it will become a place lying in ruins. In this way, even events that happened two crore years ago are obtained here. If matters from crores of years ago are to be obtained, the correct knowledge about the Manvantara must be obtained. But the mistake of India, as they say, is that Gurus couldn't know the Manvantara and go along that path.

When the Asian continent lay together, some people climbed over here. They lived in the manner of this place. When this split into different countries, some people remained here. They learned mantras and tantras and created the Vedic religion. The Vedic person became the authority here. This is the reason why the people here do not unite. These people won't touch and get close, won't touch and take. Thus, distances increased, and people moved apart from each other.

The Trimurti system was carried forward in a way that they wouldn't get close to each other. Nothing included in the four-faced karma existed anymore. It is said that the four-faced one created the four Vedas. It was said that Brahma created the four Vedas. There is no history about that Brahma. If there is to be a history, the Manvantara must come. When knowledge about the Manvantara disappeared, knowledge about Brahma disappeared. In the Trimurti system, Brahmam was conceptualized in the place of Brahma.

Brahmam should be contained in everything, right? Brahma is not like that; it is only in the creative karma. However, they made people believe that Brahma is above everything. But Brahma is not above everything. To tell the story of Brahma, Manu is needed. There is no knowledge about Manu either. Then history said it was given to Ikshvaku, the son of Surya. In that history, there was no place for Manvantara. Thus, we went into error. Dividing into the four gotras of Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, and Shudra, Vedic religion came.

When vision comes in this manner, it will be seen like a kind of smoke. In matters cleared like that, one must pay attention to what the Guru says. If you do not pay attention like that, you will go back to the path of error you went and err again. Then you will leave from here. If you leave, what comes next will be aimless.

When coming here, the vision clears due to the grace of the Guru. Only such a Guru can distinguish and tell the parts of the Trimurtis and the position of the Ganas. When starting to clearly distinguish and see each of these, if one thinks they should go somewhere and say something there, they will lose their way. That part of losing the way will not be understood. You assume that the Paramatma is likely to take form and come. If the Paramatma takes form, how will you recognize it?

Believer: It is the taking form of the six parts that is called Bhagavan. It is Sri Krishna who is seen and spoken of as omnipresent. Because Krishna is the highest among those who have come so far. Krishna is also the Paramatma.

Guru: Yes. But it doesn't end there. It is true that Krishna is the foremost among those who have come till then. But that was a little before the beginning of Kali. Therefore, we were not given the Kali Dharma. We couldn't correct people in that Dharma either. One must ascend from the eighth position to correct the Kali Dharma. There, only Arjuna was corrected and led. Only Arjuna turned. Yet, there is fear about how to kill Gurus and elders. That is when it is asked, don't you believe me? I believe. Yet the fear is not relieved. Then Krishna says; they are neither being killed, nor made to kill. Being taught in this state, that is, the Dharma of Kali being taught like this, has come out wrong. Yuga Dharma was also not made to be done. People like Drona and Bhishma are the ones killed. They are scholars and born in royal families. They wrote wrongly and stopped at the Trimurtis.

Only after passing the star group and reaching the eighth position should one even think about the karma to go to the Paramatma. One shouldn't say Paramatma. Not the soul of the Param, Krishna reached the part of the Paramatma. Did not come in karma. To bring him into that karma, standing as a Guru, he was making his disciple Arjuna do it.

Sri Krishna was born in the eighth position. To ascend from that, it must be shown from the beginning to Arjuna. The karma to cross that position must be done through the disciple Arjuna. After that, the next position is completing the Navagrahas (nine planets). In this, eight were also completed. The form ended there. The color of that formless sky is given to Krishna. Going to the Navagrahas, then the disciple must be made to do it. That is, having seen the ninth planetary position, Krishna should teach Arjuna regarding that position. But when Krishna reached here, the demons and Devas all together drove him away without letting him stay here. He must stand on the other side, acquiring everything from the eighth position where he was born, and advise the disciple. Up to eight has been advised to Arjuna as well.

Kurukshetra was shown the position of God. It was shown entirely through Kurukshetra war. Then form was lost. Later it was only colour of sky. In that sky Sree Krishna stands spread. Arjuna has gone seeing Krishna standing spread in eight and accepting him as Guru. But did not reach nine. Disciple should function ascending nine. Guru should not function there. Form went passing through nine planets, twenty seven stars and twelve zodiac signs completing this. Forms must be joined as eight, nine and ten in that sky. This is what is called tenth condition. In nine it is merging. There is no merging in tenth state. That itself becomes. There is no colour.

Though some people coming here understand this condition here, they are unable to take this. That is the defect of their destiny. They will be looking at that old one itself. This is the trouble if the way of Guru is not correct. They will be moving in that old form itself. They will be turning this colour and this form like this. This is what was shown to Arjuna. Sree Krishna said, these people - Dronar, Bheeshmar and Salyar etc are the people who destroy the position which you and I were in the past. You are not killing any of them, nor are you making them to be killed. This is its justice.

Anybody can tell the external nature of renunciation. Some people will also have vision. But how many people can see and tell clearly? Till today there has been nobody to tell clearly the shape of the stages, states and change of states of vision. Whether you are a monk or whoever, you must go to Guru to ask and understand the difference in state of vision. Otherwise the state which you have reached will not pass. It will only turn around there. You will desire to go there, to go here etc. Wherever you go, you will not get. Even if you lie without drinking water for days, you will not get.

Vivekananda is saying what he has not got clearly because he has not got a Guru in that state. This is not clear to Jesus and Prophet. Not clear to Buddha. Going begging with hand is the proof that it is not clear. Whatever is eaten must be digested. Poets have written that Nirvana has been reached. How do these poets know what Nirvana is? It is the imagination of the poets to say that Buddha is greater than Sree Krishna and to give him the status of Nirvana. He did not come knowing. So Buddha told the children here that it was a mistake.

Guru stands as Paramatma in the karma (action) got after leaving form. Paramatma is seen in this Guru. What is the soul of that Param should be known through Guru. There is no other knowledge. This is Paramabrahman. It is difficult to get a Guru who has become Paramabrahman. That Guru will sit with everybody. Guru is sitting with whatever is good and bad. It is devotion that such a Guru sends to karma.

Vedanta, having been studied, and the karma mentioned in the horoscope being combined by a person will not result in understanding this. Guru is Brahman, says Vedanta. Once the position of Brahman is reached, what and who the Guru is, is what must be investigated next. Arjuna had vision, didn't he?
