That is what Sri Krishna said: look who I was before, who you were, and what you and I were. It was after showing this that Sri Krishna made Arjuna fight the war. After the war, Parashakti, the devas, and everyone else worked together to prevent moving past the eighth state. Then Dwaraka sank. That is when it was said, there is no escape anymore, Krishnaٹٹ

If you understand the way here, obey it and then go in the old traditional way, you will perish in such a way that you will not even know where you will reach. I am talking about a subject which not even a single individual who has come so far has been able to know. Your intention should be to realize this. This is given to you by God. As long as you do not understand this, you will not be able to bring up your children by making them obey. If you are the people who have understood this, are you not the people who should search for this and work it out? Is this something to be tied in any caste or religion and watered inside their fort? No individual should work in this thinking like that. Never do it, evil will come.

Understanding this, you have been given by God as the easiest way to complete the dharma of life and to individualize it, by passing it on to your tradition. Through it, the children of this Bharath should become a model for the house, country and the world. What has happened in India today instead of that? Since it is impossible to live here today, some people have moved out of India itself and become tigers and cats saying that they have done something and completed it to uplift the world. You must impart the knowledge capable of bringing up your children properly so that this tiger and cat do not jump on the back of your children. Through those children, it will be the cause for the liberation and existence of our country.

This is the message we have got. If you do this as much as possible, doing and making others to do it in the way you decide, without telling anybody who should do it and without insisting that it should be like this, that action will surely be useful to the world. You must become fully capable to take up this action which is going to be useful to the world as God's will. Through that let what the people of the world have to get, be got as India's gift. It should be passed on through our little children. The need of today is not to give it through Upanishads which are said to be the source of Indian knowledge or through recitation of Vedas or through suktas prescribed by saints. You have to go and search for this where you have to search and suffer.

Your ancestors are not virtuous. Or if a person has come as rich, children will be born capable of cutting the head of that wealth. This is what we see completely among us today. If there are seven children, and if some of them fail in any subject, seeing the parents weeping, it will seem as if these children who are to uplift the whole world have failed in a subject and they are feeling the pain! I have a sorrow that we do not have mother or father to think that let my children be able to use properly what has been earned by the virtuous results of my ancestors, which the poor people living without being able to learn anything and without fate for food for one time did not get, and let my children get at least this much. When they are ready for the buffoonery of being satisfied by showing unparalleled sorrow if a child fails in a subject, where will the children they bring up stand? I would only say that this is the complete form of ugliness and nonsense. You should not become parents who destroy the country by making the children who do not have this aptitude to suffer in this way, teaching them unnecessarily and making them useless for the country, incendiaries and robbers.

The customary practices you show are a severe evil like this. This is the cause for your destruction. It is a severe crime you are doing to your house. It is an action which not only destroys the house, but also sows destruction for the country. Today the educated are doing robbery more than the uneducated. The education coming to your children is the one which invites destruction by imparting very bad aptitude. You should give your children only what they have aptitude for. If what they do not have aptitude for is given, bad influence is injected in him. Thus do not allow him to take up the ownership of the evil of karma.

Like the life of a wandering monk who does not know how to dress, eat, drink and bathe, there is an Avadhootha life. Like wandering merged in God reminding that, your children drink, excrete, vomit and walk through many unhygienic conditions making them useless for anything, grow up as mischievous before this world, and wherever they reach, they go there and learn to show grimaces. Giving a lot of weight to this ignorance, you have reached the action of giving bribe even to admit the children in nursery. Going from there to other things to study a little and grow bad aptitude is with a mean action which has imbibed an idea capable of pushing down everything. Even if he comes to the Ashram, what will he be doing? He will not be working to take the liberation of danger, but to take up the action which invites danger.

You who desire to come to the action called Ashram dharma should think that it is not only to clear my defects, but also to clear the defects in the action done by my ancestors. Let me have liberation if there is, let there not be if there is not. But let this country not be destroyed through my children acquiring this ignorance. At least that much love should be there in your action. I will not ask to renounce here without this. When the occasion and qualification to renounce comes, you can renounce. Never give up that desire. Do not prevent that desire. There is no use in preventing. I am not talking about the action standing around renunciation. You do not renounce. You become the children of our country. The dharma of the children who keep constant vigil about this country coming into your life, you should live for the action capable of attaining liberation for your children without your knowing. Doing and not doing that life, you can do it according to your knowledge, experience and habit. There is no use in my telling that too. Because I am convinced that you cannot be made to do it by loving and fondling you. But I have done what I have to do. I have worked so that the family defect sticking in the action of each one of you and the ignorance sticking in it do not pass on to your children. You yourself should manifest into the dharma to copy it reliably and believe that this is the action I have done so that the ownership right of that action comes to you. For that God has entrusted this world itself to you. I am issuing a good news entrusting this to you with great desire.
Guruvani
Santhigiri Janmadinapoojitha Samarppanappathippu - 2001
Gurukula Brahmaniveditham

There was a time when the world had no realization about Brahma nischayam or the glory of God. Even now it does not mean that knowledge is complete. Except that the world got the opportunity to do only the things told from Brahman from time to time, the world could not take that knowledge. Complete realization about Brahma nischayam was there only for six Manvantharas and three Chathuryugas. Sathyathranan was the great man who came at the end of the third Chathuryuga. Though he knew that he was the heir of Brahma nischayam, the secret of his own life was not fully told to him till his end.
I am saying here what has been told to me in my experience. I do not know whether there is anything beyond this.

One Manvantharam is the concept of Saptharshis. By that concept a solar system creation is formed. The solar system has nine planets having form and useful for the theory of evolution. Therefore the greatness of Rahu and Kethu has not been determined. These planets spread as twelve zodiac signs and give twelve results. In that it is not certain which all results Rahu and Kethu give. But destined things are told for everything. An incompleteness is seen for both these.

Saptharshis gave concept for a solar system creation in the calculation of nine planets, twelve zodiac signs and twenty seven stars. Scientifically and by some other experiences, there are some people who say it as seven mandalas. These seven mandalas have form and expression. But Rahu and Kethu who revolve like this sometimes travel out of place at some time. Therefore we should not desire its complete result. Because nobody can determine how the time difference will be when it comes revolving in the action of one Vyazhavattakalam (twelve years). That is, their movement is not constant. Without being able to determine that, it travels in an order.

The movement of the solar system has a measure of Brahma prakasam. Its influence may act changing here and there. But it will not leave this mandalam. If there is a difference of one second for this movement, there will be a mistake of about a yamam calculation for it. It cannot be determined accurately. But in our measurement there are seconds, minutes, nazhikas, vinazhikas and up to the very minute thrudi.
Whatever calculations there may be, there should not be any mistake in the greatness which has come in the concept of Saptharshis. That is the way of truth. That is the life of man.

There is sandhi (junction) for Manvantharam, Chathuryugas, Yugas and Yamas. Sandhyavandanam is being done as a sandhi which removes the yamasandhi. There may be people who are awake in three yamas and also people who are awake in five yamas if added. But we have been told the time of worship in eight yamasandhis.

There is a calculation of five Gurus for one yuga. These Gurus bring about the calculation of Sandhyavandanam according to Brahma nischayam and the realization of times. But we cannot say how many great men come in yugasandhi. The Brahma nischayam is described to us in four yugas. If a mistake comes in yugadharma at any time, that mistake cannot be corrected later. For that a lot of effort is required. The life and words of great men prove it.

In the knowledge of Chathurvakya told by Sathyathranan, scholars and ordinary people fell into a pit without being able to realize the times. This truth can be seen if we look at the last twenty five Chathuryugas. Our subject is what we got to know where the mistake occurred in this truth.

As proof that this mistake occurred, we have thousands of lives crossing hurdles before us. The life of man, pithru, devan, rishi and sannyasi. The path shown by the rishi standing above the devan after seeing what is the life of a muni, what is the life of a rishi, coming down like that what is the life of a devan, what is the life of a rishi under a devan in these lives is the truth standing through rishi words. There was a time when nothing could be known about this truth. A karma skill which got told from where this truth exists above the Trimurthi system was completed at Varkala. That occasion was a time of physical and mental tortures. It is not possible to count or finish telling what all types of tortures. Taking it back is indebted to that Brahma nischayam who made that Brahma nischayam a person. The life of great men is what has come without being able to decide what is the right and wrong of Manu tradition, and how it will be fulfilled.

Six Manvantharas are over. The calculation is 71 Chathuryugas in each Manvantharam. Four yugas for one Chathuryuga. The calculation is five Gurus for the fulfillment of each yuga. Kaliyuga is the smallest of yugas. This itself has 4,32,000 years. Double of this is Dwaparam. Dwaparam and Kali together form Threthayuga. Threthayuga and Kali together form Kruthayuga. From the birth of Sree Rama to the birth of Sree Krishna is the period which has come after many lakhs of years in the state of five Gurus for each yuga. It was Sree Krishna who was born as a great man who completely knew the Kali dharma before the beginning of Kali. Manu has assessed that the fourth padam, Kali, belongs to the Sudra class. That is, Kali is the time when the right to Brahma jnanam was completely destined to the Sudra after completely understanding all the subjects to be ruled and made to rule in the fourth padam. It is as an example for this that Krishna has been made to be born in Yadava kula. The prime mistake occurred twenty five Chathuryugas ago. It was indicated earlier that the word Aham Brahmasmi originated from a big mistake which occurred when the Rishi Sathyathranan, thinking to respect truth, took and saw the decisive truth which came as Chathuryugas and Manvantharas as what he was and what his predecessors were. Later when it was completed with Chathurvakyas, it was not perfection of idea, but perfection of letter that was brought about. That is the mistake which continues for twenty five Chathuryugas. Gurukula Brahmaniveditham is an action which corrects this mistake and brings about perfection of idea. This ceremony was previously conducted in a different way.

Sudra class is ignorant. Therefore it was easy to deceive them by words. Each one in the Sudra class is the children who met with that mistake. There was a practice to start alphabet at the fifth year. This ceremony was conducted equally for male and female. This had an advisory nature. This will be done before completing five years. There is no such ceremony among the Brahmin community. There is no ceremony among them except starting alphabet. The ceremony which was kept for this among the Sudra class is Kettukalyanam. Like that there were ceremonies like Thirandukalyanam, Kalyanam, Pulikudi adiyanthiram. When a girl is born and these many ceremonies are conducted, that house will become poor. Then if four girls are born, it need not be told.

A ceremony shown among the Brahmins is the Guru giving advice and starting alphabet. In the marriage ceremony they show an action destined by the birth of Vyasa. Vyasa has the name Krishna Dwaipayanan by concept action. Vyasa told us as if it came from the mouth of Krishna. It is not certain in which all yugas Vyasa has come. It is widely accepted that Vyasa is the son of a fisherwoman. The purana histories which divided and told the four Vedas and six Sastras are the truth destined and written for Hindus.

The ceremony shown by Brahmins is nine and eleven days. This ceremony is making the male and female children sit and reading out briefly the things in Puranas and Ithihasas and explaining them physically and spiritually. The summary of six Sastras and four Vedas will be read in six and four, ten days. Marriage on the eleventh day. In that marriage also they show a ceremony. Though it is not there in everyone's house now, it is there in the house of chief Thanthris. In others' house, father, mother and the most required persons sit and fill water in a big varppu (vessel), catch the fish and make the girl and boy to take it chanting Veda mantras. That indicates the birth of Vyasa.

But the ignorance they made the Sudra class to do is Kettukalyanam, Thirandukalyanam and Pulikudi. That is for the Sudra not to get Brahma jnanam. Relatives and friends will be invited to inform that a girl has come of age. An ada (sweet) will be made with navadhanyas. All together will make this girl who has come of age to sit on a padangu over this ada, and standing around, all together will throw flowers on the back of this child. This ada will be given to the Nair of illam (Brahmin house). Other adas will be cut and given to all relatives and friends. The name of this ada is Pori ada. He who eats this Pori ada will not get Brahma vidya later.

Gurukula Brahmaniveditham is the action we have started to change this wrong action. Acquiring knowledge in the action advised by Guru is Brahma vidya. For this, this child should be kept as a Brahmacharini. Children eligible for Brahma jnanam will be born in such a Brahmacharini after marriage. These children are called sadsanthanam. We did not have such a ceremony among us before this. Therefore this ceremony is the one God showed for us. It also has the meaning that the parents and the local people get the information that the girl has attained age to acquire knowledge. If this path of advice is kept, one can at least reach the state of Saraswathi, Parvathy and Lakshmi. Knowing at least this much we should bring up girls and boys in a way useful for the good of the world. They can go as Brahmachari and Brahmacharini, or as householder, in the manner of Brahmacharyam, Kaumaram, Vanaprastham and Sannyasam. This is the knowledge we got. Especially the tradition, and everyone else should know this. The position these children acquire will also be got by their parents. The purity of intention that this action is to make the purity of the tradition of Gurukula Brahmaniveditham as that of this tradition for the whole world by that soul taking birth again. What is seen in the vision got by them is the one completed in the sacrifice of many years of not only the devan and devi, but of all the prophet traditions. That is why it was said that at least the position of Saraswathi, Parvathy and Lakshmi should be got through vision. Without doing any of these sacrifices, children having vision get this state here. This action is for it to come to our children through action. But all children need not get this blessedness. This action can be made useful for the tradition of such children whose soul has no right to get this right through action. The Brahmacharis, Brahmacharinis and householders here are the proof for this.

What have the authors of Puranas in the Vedic religious system done? Puranas and Ithihasas are created in such a way to make them capable to realize the good and bad of the children and to make them the heirs of Guru's action. By the effort of Guru, we all get this blessedness when Guru is sitting. But what when Guru is not there? While the Guru is alive, through disciples or vision faces, disciples get all the skills of action of Guru-disciple relation by the blessing of Guru. This skill of action is merged and kept in nature. It should be thought whether the right of such a big ceremony is needed or not when the Guru is sitting. All these should be made a right in action, brought in dharma and should be got to the world through Guru tradition. Also, the aim of the action called Gurukula Brahmaniveditham is to clear some evil aspects which went doing according to custom including in the Vedic religion and to complete in the dharma called realization.

What we execute by this action is completing the action of Chathurvarnyam to be useful for the complete knowledge of Sathyayuga. For this, parents and guardians without the difference of male and female are the cause for the creation of the world which makes Brahma nischayam the reason. That is this Guru tradition.
Guruvani
Santhigiri Janmadinapoojitha Samarppanappathippu - 2001
Atmospheric pollution - Man's realization
Whether what our ancestors have done and established is truth or untruth, it is justice. How did we behave in this?
The fourth time is Kali. When saying Kali, we have assumed it as an ignorant time or the time of an ignorant person. This assumption is totally wrong.

There is a thing called four Vedas divided for four times. It is the person called Vyasa or Krishna Dwaipayana who has divided like that. Anyway this knowledge has amazed us. How can we celebrate the dharma of this Kali anymore?

Saying Kali is in Sudra, the Sudrahood has been operated in a way that can never be changed. When saying Kali is in Sudra, some people thought they are big people and some people thought they are the worst people. Some people felt they are a group of enslaved class.

What is the dharma of Kali? The other three times have acted and gone. If any shortcomings have occurred in acting so, it is Kali and its rightful owner Sudra to clear that shortcoming. For that Sudra must acquire knowledge. Sudra who acquires knowledge thus becomes the rightful owner of Sathyayuga as well. Nobody will become an authority just like that. Intelligence, capability and ability should be acquired for that. It should be in a knowledge according to God's will. It is because God's condition is not known that Kali has been made bad. It has come as an action which failed by spreading this ignorance throughout the world. That failure has come as many times. If told exactly, that failure is twenty five Chathuryugas old. So it is not possible to calculate and take this. Even if studied going to the moon, it is not possible to calculate this. The duration of a Chathuryuga is 12000 divine years. One divine year is 365 human years. How will this be calculated?

We will live on earth and leave the body on earth itself and go. We are studying the things up to that. As each day, big and small, we study each thing. It is a big action that we first pray, respect, respect mutually, and adopt those who teach us, parents and Gurus in ashram nature. By that action we ourselves can acquire many things. The rest is a big knowledge which we study dividing as house, country and state after we grow up. We should develop that knowledge physically and spiritually. The mischiefs and jumping as an oracle for that knowledge should be careful. Those who stayed in the ashram at least for a day will understand that this is of no use seeing all this. If those who have stayed in the ashram and have experience join them and jump as an oracle, they will become worse than others. Because they will do all unwanted works to win them. That is why they become bad. And they will become useless for the country.

By the ashram and by studying in the ashram, whatever shortcomings are there in our house, whatever shortcomings are there in the country, we are clearing and completing all those shortcomings by our intelligence, difficulty, sacrifice and action. This is the primeval knowledge acquired from the ashram. That is not sannyasa. Coming, believing and staying in the ashram is not to renounce, but to learn through life. That is what kings in ancient times have done. Even Sree Krishna is said to have studied in the ashram. Ashram is such a big institution for people like Sree Krishna to study.

Thٹٹ at effort is an ashram. The core part of every ashram is to work for the good of the world by spreading love, respect, and humility. That is the education gained from an ashram. Other than this, there is no point in claiming that I went to an ashram, learned the Vedas, learned Vedanta, and learned singing and dancing. All these mentioned things can be found everywhere.

Today, after starting to do the prayer (Akhanda Namam) practiced at Santhigiri without interruption, there is relief from all kinds of difficulties. While following the Trimurti tradition at the time, initially there were results. Later on, things started going wrong. Nothing worked, including curing illnesses. This prayer mantra was given for two people. It was received at Varkala itself. But since my name was in it, I did not agree to do it. However, a message was received to chant and strengthen it. I told this information to Pathani Swami. Then Swami said, "You will not understand what you are now. The time to understand that time will come. It will be properly understood only after your time. This is for the world".

It was in 1973 that it became convinced that this Akhandanamam is the most correct. That conviction is that nature had care about this very early. Even today there are people here who do prayer without break from the beginning. But many have not understood why it is done. There are many reasons for that. What many people have heard about prayer is that, a glance of Devan or Devi is enough, everything is done. Another is, a knowledge satisfying by doing offering or gift, and doing inner pooja of a day and closing pooja of a day.

When saying closing pooja of a day, there are many temples in Kerala which do it considering it as the biggest. In Travancore, places like Trivandrum, Vaikom, Ettumanoor and in Malabar, places from Kodungallur to Kasargod have such temples. Parasurama temples also come in this. Why large temples are built, filled with Nalambalams and Chuttambalams doing a lot of decorative works, we or people more knowledgeable than us do not know. Just to show power by our ancestors, or consider it as Kshatriyas. Those who are empowered are called Rajagurus.

A work has been done here to unite us with Vaishnava system, Saiva system and Saktheya system. But human beings will not unite like that. Because these three have come in three natures. What is needed to unite is a knowledge. What knowledge to get from this which decorated these systems and went bad with song, dance, play and noise. Now let us take Kathakali itself. It has been decorated as the tradition of Kerala. In a situation where even the governments promote it dividing into theyyamthullal and various local arts taking a knowledge from it calling each section and sub-sections by each name, how much we grew, how much we took, how much we could see. Has anybody got an opportunity to even think about this? Or even if thought, a great bad time where we cannot unite has tied everybody and turned to the path of destruction.

We all know the dharma called Sanathanam. But we are confused without being able to distinguish what is Sanathanam and what is Hindu. Sanathanam means knowing times and acting. But we do not know what this time is. And we do not know how to carry it. Sathyayuga went according to its merit. From Threthayuga we have acted and restricted like the karma gati of creation.

We are the people who have come after how many times have passed. How much time we have in this birth. What to study within this time. Is the subject passed through these many times something that can be studied and finished like that. The subject we have to study for this is Kali dharma. The dharma of Kali is not something to come distinguishing caste or religion. It is a good aspect that should happen all over the world in human dharma. However much it is tried to be suppressed in the name of freedom or anything else, we should examine the change beyond fifty years. Especially if we assess the intelligence of children within twenty years, whether it is good or bad, they have more intelligence than us. This can be clearly seen in children of two or three years of age. Even with so much visible change, we have been made to believe that Kali is bad and Kali is destruction. This situation has been served all over the world. How will we change this belief? Most people believe that we cannot change. We can change. It is for this we should work. If this cannot be changed, what is the gain for the next generation? Even within the last 25 Chathuryugas, how many crores of great men themselves have come. They themselves could not change themselves or change others according to Kali dharma. Then what about the condition of common people? Worshipped in a bad way in the state of demonic or divine, and died, many crores of souls stand like flood disaster in the atmosphere even today. They are standing as atmospheric pollution. The disaster of this atmospheric pollution affects all of us equally. The human world is told here as a whole. I do not know how many of us know the part of such a knowledge. It is when the atmosphere stands in this condition that I am saying that this can be changed. This is a big subject.

If spoken about the knowledge of our ancestors, do they have the ability of action to say the calculation of ten or five thousand or ten thousand years? How to tell them how the karma gati of yuga has reached dharma and stands? What is called the karma gati of yuga exists as long as life exists. In which way this can be changed? You should impart this knowledge to your children. You should not push the children growing up before you to the knowledge of the past you grew up. A change useful for reaching goodness should be brought about for all children within twenty or twenty five years without considering male or female, caste or religion. Within a hundred years, how many crores of souls who came and lived on earth, brought evil of karma and returned, stand as atmospheric pollution. That is not the pollution of a thousand or ten thousand years. There are pollutions of twenty five Chathuryugas itself. Even if we have to face some difficulties and troubles, this pollution can be changed. For that there is a compassion given by God here. That is not for one caste or one religion or one dharma. If one dharma is completed, what will we do to the other. Kali is a time got completely to make it possible. This truth is what I have seen and experienced through my life. God has allowed to settle this Kali dharma. You take this up so that an ability to work it out comes in each one to settle it through your children growing before you. However much you suffer, you cannot remove this acquired polluting feature from them. If it can be believed as a great dharma, that is the greatest fortune.

What we have seen and heard in the world so far is only a procession of miraculous deeds of everything from ghost to devan. The jumping showing test is one of this kind. The things which the people possessed by devis and devans directly told and showed me at Varkala Santhigiri are being remembered: a girl possessed by a ghost in the name of Madhura Meenakshi. Another ghost called Kalliyankattu Neeli having the same condition and weight. The people of South Travancore used to call this Yakshi. There are many tombs also in this same nature. If we go before this and think carefully, these demonic things will come before us and tell some words of courtesy externally and internally and making some special kind of sound, will tell us things we have never thought and heard. Things done in some ancient time and which we don't remember, karmas done by ancestors, these are our deities of worship will be told exactly. If it is a believer of prophet religion, will tell taking two words from what the prophet has said and then illustrating it. All these are the grimaces shown by a ghost having no knowledge or ability in that way. If it is a ghost with some knowledge, then no need to say.

If it is like this regarding a ghost, the things told by a soul who lived and went in the state of devan and rishi will be difficult for us to understand. The reason for that is the ignorance about the essence of the Chathurvakyas which came through an acharya in the Manu tradition. Aham Brahmasmi, Ayameva Brahma, Ayamathma Brahma, Thathwamasi, people who think how these Chathurvakyas came or how it was implemented are themselves few. Then what can we do in the part of knowledge created by a group of scholars who have no knowledge? It is not even possible to say how many souls are there in many yoga jnana systems which have become devan, devi and rishi mixed as right and wrong coming for yugas in this way. It is also not possible for man to act recognizing all this. The story told in Ramayana about Hanuman catching the Brahmarakshas which came to obstruct the yaga of Viswamithra in the magic of his siddhis in the time of Sree Rama is only an example. It is told about an incident where Hanuman brought Marunthuvazhum mala (Maruthwamala). A soul like this will appear before a good devotee and say that a thing will happen like this. And it will truly happen also. When four or five things happen truly like that, is it surprising if he feels an ego in himself? He has truly seen the cause of evil.

There are not two thousand or four thousand, but crores of souls like this in this atmosphere itself. We should understand that standing in the atmosphere, they can misguide the children who are born and growing in any way. Hanuman seva, the magic of devis and devans. Siddhi systems of rishis, all these paths are this. Any man following these paths will go astray. The truths seen immersed here and there in Sree Rama charithra are parts of this going astray. Are Rama Theerthar and Shirdi Sai bad? There is a story in circulation among Christians that when water was scooped in a palm, a pit was formed in the water in that measure. One can imagine what will happen if such things go and join in a mind which keeps even small things as big.

Such jnana and siddhi matters are happening a lot not only in India but all over the world. These are all things happening among men at all times. Whether believed or not, people give very great importance to these things.

Some celebrations popular among Hindus are Agni kavadi, Garuda kavadi and Manushya kavadi. There are people possessed by devis and devans who show wonders by wrapping a big chain heated red hot like fire around their body. If all these are applications done on the body of a man, what to do without wondering. It is our knowledge to consider this as great divinity. Walking over water and walking entering inside fire are applications of this kind. How will he who goes around telling rationalism know the internal urge of this. Why didn't A. T. Kovoor who lived amidst all this happening in Ceylon change these magic tricks? Wouldn't it have been better to change all this there itself rather than coming to India and delivering speeches? What to say other than that this is worse than firing a gun before deaf people?

I have in my memory having seen such a subject directly. The occasion when some pooja was going on in my family temple. The priest there is the velichappadu (oracle) coming from one kilometre away. He blessed and cut on his own face with the sword he had in his hand and the flesh hung down. When others stepped forward to take him for treatment for the hanging flesh, he did not agree. When he came out of the temple, the face with hanging flesh by the cut remains as before. Who will not feel wonder seeing this.

Another is, taking a big spear, a thread will be pierced in it first. The other end will be pierced in his cheek. Then he will give it in the hand of the next person. He too will take a lemon and pierce it, and pierce his cheek and give it in the hand of the next person. I have seen three or four people standing pierced in one spear like this. This happens mostly in Subramanya temple. The arrangement showing our God is like this. What all a mere magician will show before us. Who doesn't know that there is no big good or small good by this.

God appearing which has been going on among us for a long time is like this. What should we do, how should we go? If the one standing and jumping like this dies, he too is a ghost, a severe ghost. This ghost will stand in temples, mosques and places where tombs are there and show many things. It will only seem to be true. If gone to Nagoor mosque, Beemapally and Thuckalay Peerukannu Sahib's samadhi on Thursdays and Mondays, it is dance and jump from six o'clock to past midnight three o'clock. It will be stopped after three o'clock. Or if anything is shown after that, it is body grimace, it is lie. Do you think that all this will be over if philosophers and scholars write and fill pretending not to have seen any of this. It will not be over if said none of this is there, nor one will become a jnani if sits saying it is there. Because these are special qualities standing filled as atmospheric pollution. It will not change just by walking around making speeches. This fully subsides only before a jnani. That jnani will not show any jump or trick. If gone near a jnani, this will be over. If gone near a jnani, doing nothing, the ghost will wear out little by little and change over a period of time. But if that family did not respect, either the same will come again or one with the same nature will come.

Crores of demonic things like this stand as atmospheric pollution. This is the condition of the world. If this comes forcefully for a few days, he will behave like a madman without stable mind. When this comes many times and matures, he will die biting and cutting his tongue, lips and teeth. Can any rationalist or scholar or philosopher say that all this is not there? Can the doctors who are nursing the sick do it?

It is this ghost who killed Sree Krishna, and made the prophet to grieve saying jinn are ruling the world. It is known to religious scholars and theoreticians that the prophet had only the way to do penance for three months and leave the body. We have nothing to gain by establishing saying that all this is there, or not there. At least we should have the knowledge to say that things like this will not change.

Tetanus (rheumatism bending like a bow) is one of the many evils caused by demonic things. This is caused when epilepsy matures. Mostly such diseases are there in the houses of big people. When this comes in the body of some children, after some time eyes become blind. It is because of this that they become deaf and mad, and whether male or female, they have to live until death with symptoms of madness. This can be seen in abundance in children living now. Then what is the gain by rationalism and muktivadam?

These types of patients are mostly seen in foreign countries. Who knows where this soul will go when they die? Understanding what all diseases are brought standing in this atmosphere, I wish that at least the arguments that all these are there and not there are stopped.

When ghosts like this possess, a nature of discarding saying it is madness and devil is seen in people. Idiots mostly seen in the houses of doctors, grimaces shown by them due to that, disproportionate head swelling, treatment will not be effective for any of this even when they are small. Or even if effective, it can only be said as God's help. Others will only finish rolling that head till the end. What justice does the big uncle, rationalist and scholar have to say to this?

All these are the disease natures residing in the children of the houses of very big rich men. Be careful not to destroy the coming generation by passing this wealth to them. If you happen to read this note of denial written to show the tradition of ignorance, you think. Looking at the children showing great valour pretending as father, uncle, husband and wife, if you say scoundrel or thief or mean person, or in a scholarly nature is this a Bhadrakali, do you think this will change? These mean souls grow in modern civilization and fools say it is civilization. We should each think what name should be called to this man who is brought up as tiger or lion by knowledgeable persons having mean nature without knowledge who have learned to deny whatever they see.

We have only one thing to get for this by God's grace. Try to absorb the existing truth without denying saying it is there and not there. If any nature like this is seen, we obey the great man who has informed us in jnana nature. The mistake shown through Sree Rama, Sree Krishna, Rama Theertha, Jesus and Prophet has only one way to move away from among us. That is already told here. That is, you who have come as contemporaries of the great man who is a jnani to flow out the atmospheric pollutions, maintain Guru-disciple relation with that great man. You have many things to understand by such Guru-disciple relation.
Guruvani
Santhigiri Janmadinapoojitha Samarppanappathippu - 2001
A complete knowledge

If the value of India which we know is to be firm, what is the action of Manusmruthi must be told. We lost the power of action which we used to call Sanathanam. We don't know where and how we lost it. But we know today that the original nature was lost by trying to maintain a cultural life style by writing and adding various stories. Most people don't know that. We need not say it as anyone's fault. But reveal the truth that it happened like this. The mass of people seeking a solution for that cannot handle it without a condition called determination of time. We should see our time, or the time of India as the time of the world. Don't think that the calculation like saying Ramarajyam is without story. There is story, Manusmruthi tells many calculations about Yugadharma. Which is the calculation with adjustment in this? The matter got here is different.

There is a book called Veda Paryadanam by Dayananda Saraswathi. It is told a little in it. But an inability to say everything in that too has happened in the length of times. That too should not be seen as a fault. What is needed is to tolerate it. We should tolerate and behave the misfortune that has happened in all countries as in our country, which cannot be measured and marked by times, and what has happened all over the world and what has happened by the structural peculiarity of each country. If we do not show this tolerance power, it will be impossible to tell the coming generation what is the increase and decrease of ages. All these things are its preface. A few more things are added below. A few more things with cause and effect are also to be written separately. Since it is not time for that now, will inform later.

Brahma nischayam and Yugantharadharma in it happen by God's will. This is told specially seeing the change according to the shape difference of Yugadharma. That nischayam will be according to the command of Manu tradition. This which should have been for the propagation of dharma became for the propagation of logic by the logical thought and scholarship of a Guru in the Manu tradition. Due to the scholarly method of worship adopted by the people in later period, it reached a misfortune where times cannot be determined. This is a misfortune where times cannot be determined due to the method of worship which is destined. A scholar or rationalist will not know that this is a destined action. Who knows that this mistake is twenty five Chathuryugas old! In that position, though some scholars mention about Manu, they too have no certainty as to what is the time limit of Manu. The reason for that is the opportunism of the scholar who scribbled Hindu dharma that one day of Brahma is the duration of fourteen Manus. When stood with it, it became such that man cannot even think of cause and effect. This opportunism spread and Ramasabda came. When it was brought to Siddha form, Amarakosam came. Later giving importance to devan, it reached up to dasiyattam (dance of maid servant). Man fell decorating in this art form, that is the mistake. When such an art form came in siddhi mahima and the action of medicinal values, it reached up to rasavada prayogam (alchemy). Those songs are Bhogar panthirayiram and Agasthyar ezhayiram. When value determination came like this, siddhi marga called sleight of hand in God's name form appeared. When those actions came and turned into many like Hathayoga, Chandrikayoga, Hamsayoga and Rajayoga, a high tide of wonders itself happened creatively. It is not difficult for us to see it if observed today.

We are very familiar with people who call even an ordinary man as Yogeeswaran or Manthramoorthi. I have a memory saying that such worship was maintained in my house itself; and used to serve meals laying hundred and one leaves. Those who say will serve, themselves do not know how to say all the names of these moorthies.

Twenty five Chathuryugas have crossed over in this same way. How will this be realized in the goal of a man or in the goal of a devan? Making Navapashanas as kalpam and in the matter of determining how many times originated through the path of seva with medicine intake mixed with wonders in the seva method of that kalpam, what can a sannyasi or yogi or jnani who has reached the state of transition up to the devilish action called Odividya starting from Kuttichathan which is still lower including this medicinal path, do? Observe the action of the ghost and Yogeeswaran jumping and blessing today and those who go to see it. This is true in my experience also. It stands in the light of truth even today. The action specialities leaking wonders capable of doing anything even by a person learning to handle Navarathnas and Navapashanas occurring in the earth, are the cause for any disastrous events of nature like various earthquakes occurring in the earth. Hathayogam, Chandrikayogam, Hamsayogam, Rajayogam and all such items are the sleights of hand making vibration to bring it under control. Everyone knows today that these objects are reached in mining specialities and after doing research, utilized in an increased measure. But a danger is lurking in this without our knowing. If scientists did not have such a knowledge, only the result of kings banishing from the country will be attained for it. This is a trap of danger. Acquiring ability and capability in this state, what all dangers we share here within a hundred or two hundred years belonging to your or my time limit.

The place where those banished in the intelligence of kings live is America - the place where mother sits - America. That grew as business and robbery and brought it to capitalist-labourer fight and kept it mixing songs like Sathyam, Sivam, Sundaram in it. Following that, using the intelligence of film makers, looking into a big bubble in water, it can be pictured in such a way that even the picture of the earth can be seen. Like this, gas application came, reached up to the use of cooking gas and we ourselves have brought the situation where we cannot even live without it.

When Bharadwaja Samhitha originated, Guru had said that this will not suit in time speciality. Finally the difference of opinion as disciple and Guru culminated in Rama-Ravana war. This is the beginning of Bharadwaja Samhitha. But how will people know that this is difference in Guru-disciple opinion. This Bharadwaja Samhitha was taken from eastern country then. The western countries have already become its owners today. In that way even war materials are made and distributed in fighter planes. Although all these are good for our contemporaries, this has changed into a big application which corrupts Yugantharadharma itself for the coming generation. Today in some small invention they say: dark clouds go and transform in the sky and become a thing preventing the light of sun and moon from coming to the earth. In short, this is another danger symbol like chakara (mud bank) seen in the sea. This grew and all countries started handling it. Thus all combustible gases become mutual helpers. That is being clear to us today by a small thing. Gas cylinder explodes and accident happens. Who can eliminate this trap of danger reaching up to mere kerosene. The dark cloud sphere mentioned above is the item melted and gathered using all these. If this grows like a ball in the sky, hiding the sun, increases the speed or decreases the speed in the travel path of other spheres? The nine planets are the items rolling caught in between this. If this dark cloud sphere gathers amidst these nine planets, wherever it travels, it will sow destruction there. One of that is the comet which you can see directly. When this comes in science columns, it is said that whichever country it passes through, danger happens even to those countries. Today we have known that whichever country it passes through, war takes place in all those countries. In this state we are watching play without knowing the story. That came before us in many ways as drama, chavittunatakam, musical drama and today stands reached in cinema. This is our history.

Another example can be told for this. Muhammad Ghazni attacked and came to India and harmed Somnath temple many times. The father of this injurer told him a small thing for the pain of not being able to take that idol; to hold a piece of plank right above that idol. Then the idol fell down. This magnetic ring is the action done by the idol installer with magic trick to make it wonder. The idol studded with navarathnas was taken away by this attacker applying another trick to the trick done by the idol installer with this ring. Removing the navarathnas, the idol was laid as stepping stone to the mosque. This is a danger zone grown unscientifically. Can anyone eliminate the treaty of violence done to our coming generations through attaining the statecraft building up so much danger zone? It is good that scientists and sannyasis think about this. Because, who does not know that all inventions are building up fatal danger zones belonging to this category! This death junction is the asset prepared for the coming generation by everyone together. It is also the duty of the scientists who invent this to record that the danger of the invention is this. The rationalism and muktivadam written and kept by those who are called writers here saying for the good of man is not only useless, but also the biggest tragedy. Earthquake is what shows you some of these tragedies. Some parts in the earth itself will sink. The groups in the Himalayan mountain ranges and the mountain ranges which have spread up to Kanyakumari in the country of India are the result of a rotation occurring in the earth like this. It is there in all countries like this. Thus scientists have to prove which are these gases being experienced as snow mountain, cold and heat. If they want, this is the time they can prove.

Writing romantic stories, dressing up, trapping innocent children in illusions, urging them to hang double weights, and creating a pathless path, to keep them bound in excitement, creating rationalism and liberationism, and writing stories and novels, just like art enthusiasts, there exist aphoristic songs and asceticism that doesn't even use a piece of cloth, exaggerating it through antics in Kalanilayam acting. In this state, pleasingly entertaining writers and Kalanilayam artists together have copied and presented everything from Odividya to Chakyarkoothu, Ottanthullal, and Kathakali. This is today's Shudra disguise. Are those who call these disguises scientists any better than the knowledge that creates ragamalas, play, and rhythm, and known as Kalashakkottu, reveling in pyrotechnics, than the knowledge they possess? Think. Oh scientists, and writers crafting art, please do not destroy children by raining illusions on them. ٹٹ

Writing and writing, think also of the veil of ignorance which does not hesitate even to write that I too am a researcher. Let the invention be to give goodness to man. The path of truth and untruth can be found later. Record the path of the danger found out first.

Why have Harijans been suffering since the time of Sree Krishna? It was by the will of God that the Yadava dynasty in North India and the Sudra class from Nairs downwards in Kerala came into being. Even though the Chola and Pandya dynasties, and Marthanda Varma came to power by God's will, it was of no use to the Harijans. The reason for this is the ignorance of the Hindu leaders. The eighty-four castes in the Sudra class are the result of the intellectual strategy adopted by the Hindu leaders to serve their own purposes. Because of the hold of caste, they neither mingle with each other nor let others mingle. It gradually brought them down to the level of 'Na-Ayyar' (Not Ayyar). The Nair community did not understand this strategy. The Sudra class, who fight among themselves without knowing anything, is what constitutes the Hindu religion, or the Aryan religion. The title 'Na-Ayyar' was given to them to make them fight like this.

The dharma called Sanathana has not been practiced here. Sanathana has been confined to the framework of Manusmriti. But they have also outlined a danger in it. In this Manu lineage, they first brought about the Solar and Lunar dynasties. Then they wrote 'Brahmano Mama Daivatam' (Brahmin is my God). That was portrayed as the Hindu religion and changed into temples and their retinues.

The rule of Devas belongs to Treta Yuga and Dwapara Yuga. Only when Kali Yuga begins can this mistake be rectified. Only then will the dharma called Sanathana be completed. This one dharma is not practiced anywhere outside India. Understand at least one thing: after Rama, is there anyone else who can speak of a karma-gathi (path of action) in that manner? They have struggled hard to make this Rama a Vaishnava and achieve Loka-sangraham (welfare of the world). That is what is happening even today. It was out of ignorance, without knowing this karma-gathi, that they made Mahatmaji say it. That remains a dispute even today. Everyone knows who killed Mahatmaji. Even today, the karma of Godse is happening here. That karma is eager to create the Hindu religion all over India. As far as Hindus are concerned, they do not know this. Hindu people believe that this belongs to Sanathana. Look at another trick done to make them believe so: the day they started learning 'Aham Brahmasmi' (I am Brahman), from that day the misfortune of Sanathana began. Thus, through the four Vedas and Chaturvarnya, they acted without knowing the times. When they acted in that manner, that misfortune came, leading to a dharma where they did not know what the Yuga Dharmas were. When they reached that karma, Kali took over the karma-gathi of destruction and acted.

Kali is not destruction. The four varnas always exist; they are there in this Kali too. They exist in other Yugas as well. Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, and Sudra must understand about character refinement. No one doubts Satya Yuga. But there is no one to act in it. The reason is that they acted in the other three periods without knowing the proper way. Therefore, Sanskrit is a language refined in such a way that no one can get out from under the Deva. Giving an interpretation to that language, they refine it and call it the language of the Devas. Even today, the eminent scholars who believe this to be the language of the Devas do not know that this is the danger of the mistake that came in the Manu lineage. No one knows the secret that the twenty-five Chatur Yugas have acted in this manner. It is in that situation that the four-faced nature went away, and the three-faced nature came - Brahma, Vishnu, Maheshwara. People say there is no fourth head. The story concocted for that goes like this: when asked the meaning of Omkara, he did not know. So, the head was pinched off. I do not know to which blind person this matter was asked. Therefore, to avert Kali, they added the exploits of Bhadrakali in the Karma Yoga called Bhadra and started praising it. Thus, they divided and established Shaktheyam and Shaivam.

The people of South India were praised as monkeys. Hanuman, the devotee of Rama, is an example of that. The imaginary poem called Rama-rajya was fabricated by the excessive dosha of creating the Dravidian circle, making them karma-doshis (those with flawed karma) devoid of color and status. It was the gimmick of meddling with Rama-rajya, caught in the ignorance of not being able to think whether Rama-rajya should happen in this Kali, that became the cause for Mahatmaji's assassination. And in that field, they brought about the karma-dosha of calling out Om Kali, Maha Kali, Karim Kali, and Bhadra Kali, added a story of Mahisha, brought it in the place of Rama-rajya, and even implemented it. That is how Om Kali, Maha Kali, Bhadra Kali Om came about. Thus, by adding Om in all possible ways and pronouncing it, they reduced the greatness of the syllable Om. Shaktheyan, Shaivan, and the four types of people in South India followed that path. If all the people in these four states celebrate in this way, one cannot even imagine what the situation of the people in North India would be. As a result of Vaishnava, Shaiva, and Shaktheya becoming bad in that way, we say here like this:
For the sheep and the cow, two horns;
For the Ayyangar Swami, three horns.

This is also a foolish act made to be performed by us without any sense. Because the objective is that this Kali must pass unknowingly. For that, they started saying everything by adding the word 'Rama'. That is the refined language. Sanyasis and scholars have lived and died without knowing this story. No one has ever understood that all this is the system of the Hindu religion. That is the karma-gathi brought from Sabdaroopavali up to Amarakosam. It is written starting as 'Amara Nirjara Deva'. When this was imposed, it became impossible to know the calculation of time. In what was considered time, Satya Yuga was changed to be true. Treta Yuga and Dwapara Yuga were changed to the time of Devas. It was also stated that Kali is destruction. They have reached a state where the Sudra class does not know that Kali is not destruction, and they are building a fence in the Hindu system. This is the flaw of India's Dharma theory and Karma theory. At the same time, it has been said in some places in the Puranas that 'Kali is the best among times'. A word has been given just to let it be known that there is such a truth. Not for the sake of knowing. Because such a dharma is not known, Kali is the time to know what India has been experiencing and accumulating for twenty-five Chatur Yugas. I wish to inform you this much. This is the habit, thickness, and destruction of the Hindu religion.

The misfortune of the Sudra class that unknowingly celebrated the word 'Nair'! The destitute Sudra of today is the one who thinks he will perish if that is not added. Till today, even the Harijan has not understood that what has been coming for twenty-five Chatur Yugas is a danger. It is good for the government and the Hindu religion, which has lost the headquarters of the Manu lineage, to think about cultivating the karma-bodha (awareness of action) on what can be done about this. Otherwise, the danger that befell the Harijans is that they cannot think for which period the tantric rituals were written, creating ignorant deities that make one ask, 'Is this Bhadrakali?' about one's own daughter, making them known as scoundrels and beggars who act as great sinners forever and die. This ignorant Sudra is the inheritance of the caste determination tied to the head of the headless Sudra to show that he does not belong to it. Therefore, I am telling you one thing: Kali is the same for Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, and Sudra. That is the karma told to you in one word in the Bhagavatam: 'Among times, Kali is the best'.

If we cannot break the cage of mistakes we fell into without knowing what Kali Dharma is, clear our karma dosha, gain the knowledge to think what this word 'Nair' is for, and reach the Sanathana system, Kali Dharma will end without our knowledge. The paths belonging to the purity of action shown to us today as God for this purpose are Griha Suddhi (purity of home), Pithru Suddhi (purity of ancestors), and Deva Suddhi (purity of gods). Completing these three paths, the fourth is entrusted to the Guru. This is the truth of Sanathana.

Kali is the time when this is undertaken and performed in the place of Brahmavit, Brahmavaryan, Brahmavarishtan, and Brahmavareeshtan. To put it simply, Guru Dharma is correcting the mistakes of those three periods from Satya Yuga onwards. When this started to be kept as Hindu, the result of tossing it around changed Sree Krishna into the husband of sixteen thousand and eight women. What is the sastra dharma (scientific duty) for this? Or can the vidhi-vihita kala dharma (time-duty prescribed by destiny) be fitted here? The writers of today have magnified and shown it, and the cinema, which they say is one of the wonders that is a dangerous turning point, has come running. For this single reason, if people of any other country hear these things, they will reject the truth saying, 'I don't wish to walk backward, I wish to go forward'. Many such people come to India and again become worshippers of the wondrous idol. One of the mistakes in it is the karma dosha of not knowing what Kali is. The special rule of this Kali Dharma is not 'Harijans' or 'people of Hari', but the keeping called Kali-kala that shapes the theories of time. Let us rejoice that this is the time we got to be born. At least some of us might have thought, 'I belong to this downtrodden community'. Never think like that. Even Narayana Guru was pained and spoke about it. It is the achievement of the artistic trickery that has misguided it till today. The proof for this is that on the same matter, after Sree Krishna, two thousand four hundred and forty-four great souls came as gurus and prophets and suffered pain. All this is a trap of danger that we cannot fully understand. Can't we at least now change the ignorance of giving the word 'Harijan' to the great Sree Krishna and keeping the poor as Harijans? Beware of the ways in which the lack of dharma to tell the truth has misled. It is said that when Rama acted, he happened to see the karma standing above, and saying there is no point in living anymore, he went down into the river. It is written that Ramatirtha attained Jala-samadhi. Till today, it is not known where Sree Sankara's Samadhi is. About Vadalur Ramalinga, it is said like this:
Did that supreme devotee go with his body without dying?
Did the paramartha bhakta of that Parameshwara

A wonder overflows here. We can see many such instances where ignorance happened even among Sanyasis. Then how will this knowledge reach ordinary people? The dharma system of Kali is not to show wonders or to speak of what is not there. The karma with the time calculation of Kali is to speak of what is there. Did this ignorance of Yuga Dharma come from one of us, or from ordinary people?

Won't all this catch up with those who use the words Rama and Ravana? Were we not only able to deviate and travel on the path reached by Buddha, Jain, and Moses? Look at the great Jesus and Nabi themselves. The God of the Jews is waiting, saying He will come as the son of an emperor. Therefore, they could not accept Jesus or give peace to Jesus. A group of them is saying that sins were washed away by the blood of Jesus. Isn't that just like the Hindu saying, 'If you kill, the sin will end if you eat it'?

Those who know anything about the words of the Nabi should not say certain things written down by the Islamic administration. It is good to think whether those things are the knowledge shown towards truth. That is today's Shia-Sunni administration, or Shia-Sunni dispute. If it comes to the point that even prophets are drowned in this situation, how should we accept all this?

In this state, making everything twisted, composing hypocritical dramas, performing non-existent roles, the frenzy of the story-less state turned into Kathakali. And because dressing up and performing it was not enough, Darika and Kali also challenged each other and ended it. How much sense of dharma do the outdated writers have, who made a blunder-Kali happen in the word Bhadrakali which they ended like that? I am cutting it short as it will not end if I say all this.

Today, a subject to inform, wishing that the creators and worshippers of whatever art forms and murder forms evolving in this solar system must know: to share all this to man in a deserving state, artists and actors must know and behave. If not, to get the light of knowledge that is vigilant to create God's compassion towards the scholarly-foolish antics that created from your vowels to your sabdaroopavali (word forms) to remove the dangerous trap that may come, I say in your language itself. Wishing to become parents of children who can impart the karma of showing good and bad without destroying the poor people who are eager to overflow with compassion for life, who are in the intellectual exercise of thinking short as mad, madman, ignorant, and knowledgeable, making them owners of the subconscious mind without making them madmen and madwomen - to act and see for the light of truth,
Well-wisher of you all.
Guru Vani
